are being published in original form with their translations in modern languages.
Also being published are catalogues of Jain bhandaras, inscriptions, studies on art and architecture by competent scholars and also popular Jain literature.

PREFACE to the first Edition
With the publication of this part containing the Uttarapurāņa by Guņabhadra, the Bhāratiya Jñānapītha, Banaras, has to its credit a signal achievement in presenting to the world of scholars the celebrated Sanskrit work, the Mahāpurāņa (MP) or the Trișaști-laksaņa-mahāpurāņa-samgraha (TLMPS), of Jinasena-and-Guņabhadra, in three handy volumes. As compared with the three or four earlier editions of this work, in part or full, with Marathi, Hindi and Kannada translations, this edition is characteristically superior. The Sanskrit text is critically presented after collating it from a number of Mss. important readings from which are duly noted; it is accompanied, just below, by a fluent Hindi praraphrase; there is an exhaustive Introduction in Hindi which not only puts together all information about the authors but also touches some important topics from the work itself; lastly, there is an alphabetical Index of the verses. Thus this edition meets the needs of a pious reader, and goes a great way to satisfy the demands of a critical scholar.
The MP or the TLMPS, as its title indicates, is a great narrative of the ancient times, basically describing the lives of 63 Saläkāpuruşas, namely, 24 Tīrthakaras, 12 Cakravartins, 6 Balabhadras, 9 Nārāyaṇas and 9 Pratinārāyanas recognised and honoured by Jainism. These biographies do not cover only one life of theirs, but present a detailed account of the career of their souls through various earlier births and also indicate their march on the path of religious and spiritual progress. In fact, these lives hold before the religious aspirants various facets of the spiritual career of great many souls that inspire religious confidence in others and lay down spiritual standards for them.
The entire narration is put in the mouth of Gautama and delivered in reply to the enquiry of king Sreņika, both of whom are historical persons. These biographies of souls give many an occasion to the authors to introduce various topics of traditional and conventional character and to embody in the work mythological, religious, dogmatical, sacramental and ritualistic details, and thus make the whole work almost an encyclopedia of Jainism. We get here a graphic description of the evolution of human society along the march of time and of what the great souls of the past did for man in the beginning. The careers of migrating souls bring before one the glim




Page #8
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
﻿________________

[B]
pses of the whole universe and its ideological associations. No opportunity to introduce poetical descriptions, ethical sermons, moral exhortations, theoretical details about dreamns, town-planning, polity etc., religious dogmas and practices, polemical attacks and refutations, and technical information, is ever missed with the effect that the narratives get enriched by a variety of stuff which at once demonstrates the deep learning and width of hereditory scholarship the authors of this work possessed.
The MP is a magnificent traditional history so far as the great heroes of Sramanic culture are concerned. Rich details about the Kulakaras like Nābhi, about Tirthakaras like Vņşabha, about Cakravartins like Bharata and others are presented with deep interest. It is here that we get the tales about Rāma and Rāvaņa, about Kțşņa and Pāndavas, about Bāhubali, Brahmadatta, Jivamdhara, Vasu, Nārada and many other luminaries which are of immense significance for a student of comparative mythology.
In describing the military campaign of Bharata, the author introduces important geographical information, though conventional in many details. The descriptions of Kalpavřksas, numerals, three worlds, various mountains, philosophical schools, divisions of knowledge, renunciation, rituals, samskāras, penances, meditation, Samavasaraņa etc. have enriched the work with religious and cultural details of great importance. Some socio-cultural topics deserve careful study and interpretation. Apart from the code of layman's and ascetic's morality which is elaborated throughout the work, we find in this work many ideas on statecraft and worldly wisdom expressed in a striking manner.
While composing this MP, Jinasena and Guņabhadra have drawn a good deal of information from canonical tradition and post canonical texts like the Tiloyapannatti of Yativșsabha, as well as the Vägartha-samgraha of Kavi Parameșthi. Their performance proved so authoritative, magnificent and exhaustive that its prototypical predecessors were almost eclipsed. It may not be surprising, therefore, that works like that of Kaviparamesthi came to be neglected and in course of time lost beyond recovery.
This MP has served as a model, if not necessarily a direct and the only source for many subsequent authors like Puşpadanta, Hemacandra, Āsādhara, Cāmundarāja, and the author of Tamil Śrīpurāna, etc. who composed their works in Apabhramsa, Sanskrit, Kannada and Tamil. Besides, many Jaina authors are directly or indirectly indebted to this class of works for patterns of details and descriptions with which they enriched their poems on select themes centring round one or the other hero, a Tirthamkara, a Cakravartin, or any individual hero of antiquity like Bahubali, Pradyumna, Jivandhara etc.




Page #9
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
﻿________________

[C]
The MP is divided into two parts, Adipurāņa in 47 Parvans and Uttarapuraṇa in 29 Parvans: the entire work thus has 76 Parvans. The total Granthägra comes to about 20 thousand slokas. Of the Adipurāṇa, 42 Parvans and three verses more were composed by Jinasena (about 12 thousand slokas) and the remaining work by his pupil Gunabhadra. The Adipuraṇa covers the biography of the first Tirthakara and first Cakravartin, and the Uttarapurāṇa deals with the lives of the remaining Tirthakaras and other Trişaşti Purusas. The Uttarapurāņa (about eight thousand ślokas in extent) obviously therefore becomes more enumerative than descriptive.
As an able exponent of Jainism in its manifold aspects and as a successful master of Sanskrit language, Jinasena occupies a unique place in Indian literature by both the quantity and quality of his contributions. Very little is known of his personal life. We get, however, some glimpses of his personality from some of his own poetic expressions at the close of his commentary Jayadhavalā. Almost as a boy he appears to have accepted renunciation, leading a strict celebate life and devoting himself wholly and solely to religious and scholarly life. Though physically weak and not quite handsome, he was strong in his penances and gifted with intelligence, forbearance and modesty. He was an embodiment of knowledge and spiri
tualism.
As a monk Jinasena was more an institution than an individual. He was a great disciple of a greater teacher, Virasena, whose Jayadhavala commentary he completed in 837 A.D. just as his pupil Gunabhadra completed his Mahāpurāṇa posthumously some years before 897 A.D. He belonged to the ascetic line or family called Pañcastūpanvaya to which belonged Guhanandi, Vṛṣabhanandi, Candrasena, Aryanandi and Virasena. This Pañcastūpānvaya had once its home in the North, in Eastern India; the monks of this line were perhaps the greatest custodians of the knowledge of Karma Siddhanta; and they travelled via Rajaputana and Gujaratas far as Sravana Belgol in the South carrying with them the hereditory learning of the Karma doctrine and pursuing their religious path of severe penances. Virasena and Jinasena attained such a position and eminence that after them the Senänvaya or Senagana came to be mentioned as the family or line of teachers almost replacing the Pañcastūpanvaya.
Jinasena lived in an age of political prosperity and stability as well as academic fertility. The contemporary kings were Jagattunga and Nṛpatunga or Amoghavarsa (815-877 A.D.) of the Raṣṭrakūta dynasty, with their capital at Manyakheta which became a centre of learning. Amoghavarṣa was not only a mighty monarch but also a patron of letters and a man of academic aptitude and literary attainments. A Kannada work, Kavirajamārga, on




Page #10
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
﻿________________

[D ] poetics is attributed to him. He was a great devotee of Jinasena whose ascetic virtues and literary gifts must have captivated his mind. He soon became a devout Jaina and renounced the kingdom in preference to religious life as mentioned by him in his Sanskrit wosk Praśnottara-ratnamālā and as graphically described by his contemporary Mahāvīrācārya in his Ganitasāra-samgraha. (See Jaina Siddhānta Bhāskara IX, and Anekānta V, page 183) His reign was victoriously prosperous and the span of his career pretty long.
After finishing his training in various branches of traditional learning like grammar, poetics, Nyāya etc. under his teachers like Virasena and Jayasena, it seems, Jinasena began his literary career by composing (sometime before 783 A.D.) the Pārśvābhyudaya, a Sanskrit Kāvya, a curio in Sanskrit literature. In this poem he incorporates in every verse one or two lines of the Meghadūta of Kālidāsa in their serial order, the remaining lines being composed by himself. In this way the whole poem of Kálidāsa is subjected to the poetic art known as samasya-purana. Though the stories are basically different, the lines of the Meghadūta get fitted admirably in the Pārsvābhyudaya. Composition by samasyā-pūraña puts a number of restrictions on the poet who undertakes it. Jinasena has achieved it so naturally and skilfully that while reading Pārsvābhyudaya by itself one hardly suspects that it embodies another poem of different theme as well as contexts. The Pārévābhyudaya is a remarkable tribute to Jinasena's mastery over Sanskrit and abilities as a poet. His compliments to Kālidāsa's poem at once ennoble his personality. It is only a merited poet that can admire another poet. On this poem, Professor K.B. Pathak has remarked thus : 'This poem is one of the curiosities of Sanskrit literature. It is at once the product and the mirror of the literary taste of the age. The first place among Indian poets is allotted to Kālidāsa by consent of all. Jinasena, however, claims to be considered a higher genius than the author of Cloudmessenger.' (The Journal of the Bombay branch of the R.A.S., No. XLIX, vol. XVIII, 1892; also his ed. of Kālidāsa's Meghadūta, 2nd ed., Poona 1916, Intro. pp. xxiii etc.)
After completing the Dhavală commentary on the Şațkhandāgama in 72 thousand Granthägras, Virasena took up the Jayadhavalā commentary on the Kaşāya-prābhịta. He passed away when he had composed just 20 thousand Granthāgras. It was left consequently to his worthy disciple Jinasena to complete that commentary by composing some 40 thousand Grathāgras more (in 837 A.D.). These voluminous commentaries show their depth of learning and their mastery over the entire range of Jainology, especially the Karma Siddhānta. These works contained all that was worth




Page #11
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
﻿________________

[
E
]
knowing in that context, practically absorbing the carlier Sanskrit and Prakrit commentaries. The poetic abilities of Jinasena are explicit from his memorable poem, Pärśvābhyudaya, and the depth of his wide learning from his Jayadhavalā. This twofold ability of Jinasena is seen all the more blooming in his Mahāputāņa.
The MP as a systematic exposition of Jaina traditions and principles is sufficiently appreciated by the specialist; but the literary qualities of this work have not attracted the attention of the students of Sanskrit literature to the extent that they deserve. Many sections of the MP present an exquisite specimen of Kävya. Jinasena shows an intelligent acquaintance with the works of his predecessors in the field. He handles Sanskrit language with ease and facility and further invests it with dignity. The Sahasranāma shows how fully he has availed himself of both the strength and weakness of Sanskrit language, grammar and vocabulary. He is a consummate master of versification, and now and then he has attended to even poetic and metrical tricks. His descriptions are exhuberantly rich and full of poetic embellishments, both of sense and sound. Professor Pathak was already attracted, 'though casually, by Jinasena's 'richness of fancy, copiousness of imagery and fluency of verse seen in the MP. It is a sad event in the history of Sanskrit scholarship that Jinasena left this work incomplete. His pupil Gunabhadra, with much hesitation and after waiting for some time, but as a sacred duty to his teacher, had to complete it which was later consecrated by Lokasena, a pupil of Guņabhadra, in 897 A.D. It is a memorable event that Virasena, Jinasena and Guņabhadra formed a continued and composite academic personality ushered into existence as if for the purpose of completing three significant works of Indian literature, namely, Dhavala, Jayadhavalā and Mahāpurāņa which were too big and profound to be completed in one span of life by any one individual.
Besides completing his teacher's Mahāpurāņa, Guņabhadra composed two other Sanskrit works, the Atmānuśāsana, a religious and didactic anthology in 272 verses of different metres, and the Jinadattacarita, a poem in nine cantos.
Earnest students of Sanskrit literature in general and of Jaina literature in particular feel highly obliged to Shriman Seth Shānti Prasādji and his accomplished wife Shrimati Ramā Rāniji who founded the Bhāratiya Jnan-.
pith which is publishing important Prākrit and Sanskrit works. Not minding the cost involved they are arranging the publication of these works with one great and laudable object that such gems of ancient Indian literature should not be allowed to be lost in oblivion. Words cannot adequately express their spirit of self-sacrifice and love of learning for its own




Page #12
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
﻿________________

[F]
sake. If the Jñanapiṭha Lokodaya Granthamālā aims at educating the public at large, the Jñanapiṭha Murtidevi Jaina Granthamālā maintains respectfully the prestige of ancient Indian learning especially in its neglected branches. Thus the Jñanapiṭha is really serving a national cause and a great cultural purpose; and all its publications are enriching our national language Hindi.
Shri Ayodhyāprasad Goyaliya is pushing the activities of the Jñanapitha with zeal and sincerity. Thanks are due to Pt. Pannalal Sahityacharya who prepared this edition of the Mahapurana with a lucid Hindi translation. We have every hope that this edition will give fresh impetus to the study of Mahapurāņa in its various aspects.
July 1954.


H. L. Jain, A. N. Upadhye.

ācārya guṇabhadra kṛna uttarapurāṇake prakāśanake sātha jinasena aura guṇabhadrakṛta 'triṣaṣṭi-lakṣaṇamahāpurāṇa-saṃgraha' aparanāma 'mahāpurāṇa' tīna bhāgoṃmeṃ pūrṇarūpase prakāśita ho gayā| isa suprasiddha saṃskṛta granthako aise sundara rūpameṃ vidvatsaṃsārake sanmukha upasthita karanekā śreya 'bhāratīya jñānapīṭha, kāśī' ko hai| isase pūrva āṃśika athavā pūrṇarūpameṃ hindī, marāṭhī va kannaḍa anuvādoṃ sahita isa granthake tīna cāra saṃskaraṇa prakāśita ho cuke haiṃ| kintu unakī apekṣā prastuta saṃskaraṇa apanī kucha viśeṣatāoṃke kāraṇa adhika upayogī hai| yahā~ saṃskṛta pāṭha aneka prācīna hastalikhita pratiyoṃke milānake paścāt samālocanātmaka rītise niścita kiyā gayā hai, aura upayogī pāṭhāntara aṅkita kiye gaye haiṃ| pratyeka pṛṣṭhapara saṃskṛta mūla pāṭhake sātha-sātha dhārāvāhī hindī anuvāda bhī diyā gayā hai| hindīkī suvistṛta prastāvanāmeṃ pranthakāroṃke sambandhakī samasta jñāta bātoṃkā saṃgraha kara diyā hai, tathā granthake kucha mahattvapūrṇa viṣayoṃkā bhī paricaya karāyā gayā hai| antameṃ padyoṃkī varṇānukramase sūcī bhī de dī gaī hai| isa prakāra yaha saṃskaraṇa dharmānurāgiyoṃke svādhyāyake lie aura ālocanaśīla vidvānoṃke lie samāna rūpase upayogī siddha hogā|
mahāpurāṇa apane nāmānusāra prācīna kālakā eka mahān ākhyāna hai| isameṃ jainadharmakī mānyatānusāra caubīsa tīrthakara, bāraha cakravartī, nau balabhadra, nau nārāyaṇa aura nau pratinārāyaṇa, ina vesaṭhaśalākā puruṣoṃkā mukhyataḥ jīvana-caritra varṇana kiyā gayā hai| yahā~ ukta mahāpuruṣoṃke kevala eka hī jīvanakālakā varṇana nahīṃ hai, kintu unake aneka pūrvajanmoṃkā bhī vivaraṇa diyā gayā hai, jisase unakī dhārmika va ādhyāsmika unnatikā mārga bhī spaṣṭa dikhāī detā hai| yathārthataḥ ina caritroṃ dvārā dharmānurāgiyoṃke samakṣa aneka ātmāoṃke ādhyātmika vikāsake nānā dṛśya upasthita hote haiṃ jinase pāṭhakoṃke hṛdaya meṃ dhārmika śraddhā evaṃ ādhyātmika ādarśa upasthita ho jāte haiṃ|
___ mahāpurāṇakā samasta ākhyāna mahārāja śreṇikake praśnoṃke uttarameṃ bhagavān gautama gaṇadharake mukhase prasūta huā hai| gautama gaṇadhara aura śreṇika ye donoṃ hī vikhyāta aitihāsika purupa haiṃ| caritroṃ ke citraṇameṃ granthakāroṃko aneka paramparāgata rūḍha viṣayoṃke varṇanakā avasara milā hai, aura unhoṃne apanī racanāmeṃ nānā paurāṇika, dhārmika, saiddhāntika, sāṃskārika tathā karmakāṇḍa sambandhī vivaraṇa upasthita kiye haiṃ| isa prakāra yaha grantha prāyaḥ jainadharmakā viśvakośa bana gayā hai| yahā~ hameṃ mānava samājake kālānusāra vikāsakā sajīva citraṇa tathā ādikālīna mahāpuruṣoṃke loka-kalyāṇakārī kāryoṃkā paricaya milatā hai| jīvoṃke janmāntara varṇanoṃmeṃ hameṃ samasta loka aura tatsambandhī mānyatāoṃkī spaṣṭa jhā~kiyā dikhāī detī haiṃ| kāvyātmaka varṇanoṃ, dhārmika pravacanoṃ, naitika upadeśoṃ, rūḍhigata svamī, nagara-yojanāoṃ, rājanīti ityādi, tathā siddhānta aura sadācāra evaṃ mata-matāntaroṃke khaṇḍana-maṇḍana va kalātmaka bātoṃke varṇana karanekā kahīṃ koī avasara kuśala kaviyoṃne apane hāthase nahīṃ jāne diyā| isakā pariṇāma yaha huā hai ki ākhyānoṃ meṃ sundara vaicitrya ā gayā hai jisase granthakāroṃkī viśāla vidvattā evaṃ paramparāgata prakāṇḍa pāṇḍityakā patā calatā hai|
mahāpurāṇa śramaṇa saṃskṛtike mahāpuruṣoṃkā śreṣṭha paramparāgata itihāsa hai| yahā~ nābhi ādika kulakaroṃ, vṛṣabhādi tīrthaṃkaroṃ, bharatādi cakravatiyoṃ ādike suvistṛta varṇana baḍa़e rocaka ḍhaṅgase prastuta kiye gaye haiṃ| yahā~ hama rāma aura rāvaṇa, kṛṣṇa aura pāṇḍava, tathā bāhubalī, brahmadatta, jīvandhara, vasu, nārada ādi aneka mahattvaśālī vyaktiyoṃke kathānaka prāpta hote haiṃ jo kathāoṃke tulanātmaka adhyayanake lie atyanta upayogī hai|
kavine bharatakī vijaya-yātrāke prasaṅgameṃ bahuta-sī mahattvapūrṇa bhaugolika sūcanāe~ dī haiṃ, jo aneka bātoṃ meṃ rūḍhigata honepara bhī upayogī haiṃ| kalpavṛkṣa, gaṇanā, trailokya, nānā parvata, darśana, jñānabheda, vairāgya, karmakāṇḍa, saṃskāra, tapa, dhyāna, samavasaraṇa ādike varṇanoṃ dvārā yaha racanā dhārmika va sāṃskṛtika mahatvakī vividha vārtāoṃse khūba paripuṣṭa huī hai| inameṃke aneka sāmājika va sāṃskṛtika viṣaya dhyānase adhyayana karane aura samajhane yogya haiṃ| pranthameṃ sarvatra vyāpta śrāvakadharma va munidharmake atirikta hameṃ yahā~ prabhāvaśālī rītise abhivyakta bahutasī rājanīti aura loka-vyavahāra-vātā bhī milatī hai|

mahāpurāṇāntargata uttarapurāṇa mahāpurāṇakī racanāmeṃ bhācārya jinasena aura guṇabhadrane āgamika paramparā tathā yativṛṣabhakṛta tiloya-paṇṇaśiva kavi parameṣṭhi kṛta 'vāgartha saṃgraha' jaisīāgamottara racanāoṃkā bhī bahuta kucha ādhāra liyā hai| kintu unakī yaha kṛti itanī prāmāṇika, sanipūrṇa aura śreṣṭha siddha huī ki usakī tattaviṣayaka pūrvakālīna racanāe~ prāyaḥ andhakārameṃ paḍa़ gaī| ataḥ yaha koī āścaryakī bāta nahīṃ ki kavi parameṣṭhī jaise graṃthakāroṃkī racanāeṃ upekṣita ho gaī aura kramase kālake gālameṃ samā gaī|
yaha mahāpurāṇa apabhraśa kavi puṣpadanta, saṃskṛta kavi hemacandra aura māśādhara, kannaḍa kavi cāmuṇḍarāya evaṃ śrīpurāṇakāra tāmila kavi ādikī racanāoṃke lie yadi sākṣāt aura ekamātra ādhāra nahīṃ to ādarśa avaśya rahā hai| isake atirikta jina jaina lekhakoṃne kisī eka tīrthakara, cakravartī athavā bāhubalī, pradyumna, jīvaṃdhara ādi prācīna mahāpuruṣakā caritra likhā hai, ve bhī apanī racanāoṃke poṣaka varṇana aura vistārake lie inhīṃ graṃthoṃke ṛṇī haiṃ|

jainadharmake vividha aṃgoṃke suyogya vyākhyātā tathā saṃskṛta bhāṣāke saphala kalākārake nāte jinasena apanī racanāke pramāṇa aura guṇa ina donoṃ dṛṣṭiyoṃse bhāratīya sāhityameṃ eka advitīya sthāna rakhate haiṃ| unake vaiyaktika jīvanake sambandhameṃ hamārī jānakārī bahuta kama hai, tathāpi apanī jayadhavalā ṭīkāke antameṃ unhoṃne jo kucha padya-racanā kī hai usase unake vyaktitvakī kucha jhalakeṃ mila jātī haiṃ| jāna paḍa़tā hai, unhoṃne apane bālyakālameṃ hī jina-dīkṣā grahaṇa kara lī thī, aura tabhīse ve nirantara kaṭhora brahmacaryake pālana evaṃ dhārmika va sāhityika pravṛttiyoṃ meṃ hī pūrṇata: saṃlagna rahe | yadyapi ve śarīrase kṛśa the aura dekhane meṃ sundara bhī nahīṃ the, tathāpi ve tapasyāmeṃ sudṛḍha aura buddhi, dhairya evaṃ vinayādi guṇoṃmeṃ pratibhāvān the| ve jñāna aura adhyātmake mūrtimān avatāra hī kahe jā sakate haiṃ|
munidharmakī dṛṣṭise jinasena eka vyaktimātra nahīṃ kintu eka saṃsthāke samāna the| ve vīrasena jaise mahān guruke mahān śiṣya the| unhoṃne apane gurukī jayadhavalā ṭīkāko śaka saṃvat 759 (san 837 ī.) meṃ samāpta kiyā| usī prakāra unake śiṣya gugabhadrane unakī mṛtyuke paścāt unake mahāpurāṇako śaka saṃ0 819 (san 897 īsvī) se kucha pūrva pūrṇa kiyā| ve pacastūpānvaya nāmaka muni sampradāyake sadasya the| isī sampradāyameṃ guhanandī, vṛṣabhanandī, candrasena, āryanandī aura vīrasena bhī hara the| isa paṃcastūpānvayakā mukhya kendra kisī samaya uttara-pūrva bhāratameṃ thā| anumānataḥ isī anvayake muni jaina karma-siddhānta sambandhī jñānake sabase baḍa़e saṃrakṣaka the| ve rājapūtānā aura gujarāta hote hue dakṣiṇa bhāratameṃ śravaṇabelgula taka pahu~ce| ve jahā~ gaye vahā~ apane paramparāgata karmasiddhāntake jñānako lete gaye, aura kaṭhora tapasyāke dhārmika mārgakā bhī anusaraṇa karate rahe| vīrasena aura jinasenane aisī pratiṣṭhā prāpta kī ki unake paścāt unakā munisampradāya paṃcastūpānvayake sthānapara senānvaya athavā senagaṇake nāmase hī adhika prasiddha ho gayā|

mahāpurāṇāntargata uttara purāṇa
citraṇakā prācurya tathā pacaracanākī dhārāvāhikatā ādi guṇa dṛṣṭigocara hote haiṃ unase prophesara pāṭhaka bahuta ākarṣita hue| saṃskṛta sāhitya ke itihāsakī yaha bhī eka durbhāgyapūrṇa ghaṭanā hai ki jinasena apanī isa racanāko apūrṇa choḍa़kara paraloka sidhāra gaye| unake śiṣya guṇabhadrane baḍa़e saṃkocake sātha, kucha kāla ṭhahara kara, apane guruke prati puṇya kartavya samajhakara, isa granthako san 897 īsvīmeṃ pūrṇa kiyā aura guṇabhadrake śiṣya lokasenane usakī pratiṣṭhā karāī| yaha eka baḍa़ī smaraṇīya ghaṭanā hai ki vīrasena, jinasena aura guṇabhadra ina tīnoṃkā avicchinna aura susaṃghaṭita eka hī sāhityika vyaktitva pāyā jātā hai| isa asādhāraṇa trimūrtikā avatāra dhavalā, jayacavalā aura mahāpurāṇa ina tīna bhāratīya sāhityakī nidhiyoṃko utpanna karaneke lie huā jāna paḍa़tā hai, kyoṃki ukta graṃtha eka vyakti dvārā eka jīvanakālameṃ sampanna karanā asaṃbhava thā |

apane gurukī kṛti mahāpurāṇakī pūrtike atirikta guṇabhavane do aura saṃskṛta granthoṃkī racanā kīeka 'ātmānuśāsana' jisameṃ dhārmika va naitika 272 paryokā samāveśa hai; aura dūsarī 'jinadarācarita' jo nau sagakā prabandha kāvya hai|
saṃskṛta sāhityake aura viśeṣataḥ jaina sāhitya ke anurāgī śrīmān seṭha śāntiprasādajī tathā unakī viduṣī dharmapatnī śrīmatī ramārānījīke bahuta kṛtajña haiṃ, kyoṃki unhoṃne bhāratīya jñānapīṭhakī sthāpanā karake baḍa़e mahattvapūrṇa saṃskṛta aura prākṛta granthoṃkā prakāśana kiyā hai aura kara rahe haiṃ| isa prakāśanameṃ vyayakī koī cintā na kara unhoṃne kevala yaha praśaṃsanīya dhyeya rakhā hai ki prācīna bhāratīya sāhitya ke sundara ra andhakāra meṃ paḍa़e na raha jāyeṃ| isa sambandhameṃ unake nisvārtha tyāga aura sāhitya premakī pūrṇataḥ sarāhanā karanā śabdasāmarthya se bāhara kī bāta hai | jahā~ 'jñānapīṭha lokodaya graṃthamālā' jana sādhāraṇa meṃ jñānaprasārakā kārya kara rahī hai, vaha 'jñānapīṭha mūrtidevī jaina prathamālā' bhāratakī prācīna sāhityika nidhi, aura viśeṣataḥ usake upekṣita aṅgakā vinīta bhāvase sarakāra aura utkarṣa kara rahī hai| isa prakāra jñānapīṭha eka śreṣṭha rāṣṭrīya dhyeya va mahān sāṃskṛtika prayojanakī pūrti meṃ saṃkhjha hai| usake samunnatimeṃ bhī sahāyaka ho rahe haiṃ|
samasta prakāśana rāṣṭrabhāṣā hindīkī
bhāratīya jñānapīṭhake maṃtrī śrī ayodhyāprasādajī goyalīya jñānapīṭhake kāryako gatiśīla banāye rakhane meṃ baḍa़ī tatparatā aura laganase prayamaśīla hai|
mahāpurāṇa ke isa saṃskaraṇako hindī anuvāda sahita susajjita karaneke lie paṃ0 paścālālajī sāhityācārya hamāre dhanyavādake pātra haiṃ |
hameṃ pūrṇa āśā aura bharosā hai ki yaha saṃskaraṇa mahāpurāṇake nānā dṛṣṭiyoṃse adhyayana anveṣaṇa kārya meṃ nava-sphūrtidāyaka siddha hogā |

(baṃkeya) kā putra thā| usa samaya samūcā vanavāsa (vanavāsi) pradeśa lokādityaka hī vaśame rahā| uparyukta baṃkāpura, śraddheya pitā vīra baṃkeyake nāmase lokādityake dvārā sthāpita kiyā gayā thā aura usa jamāne meṃ use eka samṛddhiśālī jaina rājadhānī honekā saubhāgya prāpta thā| baṃkega bhī sāmānya vyakti nahīṃ thā| rāṣṭrakūṭa nareśa nṛpataṃgake lie rājyakāmi jaina vīra baṃkeya hī pathapradarśaka thā | mukulakā putra erakori, erakorikā putra ghora aura ghorakā putra baṃkeya thā| baṃkeyakā prapitāmaha mukula śubhatuṃga kṛṣṇarāja kā, pitāmaha erakori śubhatuṃgake putra dhruvadeva kā, evaṃ pitā ghora cakrī goviṃda rāja kā rājakārya-sārathi thā| isase siddha hotā hai ki lokāditya aura baṃkeya hī nahīṃ, inake pitāmahādi bhī rājakārya paṭu tathā mahāśūra the||
nṛpatuṅgakī baṃkeya para aṭūṭa śraddhā thī| vahī kāraṇa hai ki eka lekhameṃ nṛpatuṃgane baṃkeyake sambandha meṃ 'vitatajyotiniśitāsirivāparaḥ' kahā hai| pahale baṃkeya nṛpataṃgake āpta senānāyakake rūpameṃ aneka yuddhoṃ meṃ vijaya prāpta kara nareśake pūrṇa kṛpāpātra bananeke phalasvarūpa viśāla vanavāsa (banavāsi) prāntakā sāmanta banā diyā gayā thā| sāmaṃta baṃkeyane hī gaṅgarāja rājamallako eka yuddha meṃ harā kara baṃdī banā liyā thā| balki isa vijayopalakṣya meṃ bharī sabhāmeṃ vīra baṃkeyako nṛpapaṃgake dvārā jaba koī abhīṣṭa vara mā~ganekī ājñā huī taba jinabhakta baṃkeyane sagadgada mahārāja nṛpatuṅgase yaha prārthanā kī ki 'mahārāja ! aba merī koī laukika kāmanā bākī nahīṃ rahī| agara āpako kucha denā hī abhīṣṭa ho to kolanūrameṃ mere dvārā nirmāpita pavitra jinamandirake lie sucāru rūpase pūjādi kārya-saṃcālanārtha eka bhū dāna pradāna kara sakate haiṃ, | basa, aisā hī kiyā gayā| yaha ullekha eka viśāla prastarakhaṇḍameṃ śāsana ke rūpameṃ āja bhī upalabdha hotā hai| baṃkeyake asīma dharmapremake lie yaha eka udāharaṇa hī paryāpta hai| isa prasaṃgameṃ yaha ullekha kara denā bhī āvaśyaka hai ki vīra baṃkeyakī dharmapatnī vijayā baḍa़ī viduṣī rahī| isane saṃskṛtameṃ eka kāvya racā hai| isa kāvyakā eka padya śrīmān beṃkaṭeśa bhīma rāva ālūra bī.e.ela. ela.bī. ne 'karṇāṭakagatavaibhava' nāmaka apanī sundara racanāmeṃ udāharaṇake rūpa meṃ uddhata kiyā hai| baṃkeyake suyogya putra lokādityameṃ bhī pūjya pitāke samāna dharma premakā honā svābhāvika hī hai, sātha hī sātha lokāditya para 'uttarapurāṇake racayitā śrī guṇabhadrācāryakā prabhāva bhī paryāpta thā | isameṃ sandeha nahīṃ ki dharmadhurīṇa lokādityake kāraṇa baṃkāpura usa samaya jaina dharmakā pramukha kendra bana gayā thā| yadyapi lokāditya rāṣṭakūṭa-nareśoṃkā sāmanta thā phira bhī rāṣṭa kūṭa śāsakoṃke śāsanakālameṃ yaha eka vaiśiṣṭaya thā ki unake sabhī sāmanta svatantra rahe| ācārya guṇabhadrake śabdoṃ meṃ lokāditya śatru rūpī andhakārako miṭānevālā eka khyātiprāpta pratāpī śāsaka hī nahīṃ thā, sātha hī sātha śrīmān bhī thā| usa jamānemeṃ baṃkāpurameṃ kaī jina-mandira the| ina mandiroṃko cālukyādi śāsakoṃse dāna bhī milā thā| baṃkāpura eka pramukha kendra honese vahāṃ para mahāpurāṇāntargata uttarapurāṇa vastutaḥ dekhane lāyaka hī hogā, mujhe to baḍa़ī dera taka vahā~se haṭanekī icchā hī nahīṃ huī| kile ke andara isa samaya eka sundara jinālaya avaśiṣṭa hai vahā~ vāle ise 'āvata mūsa kaṃba galavasti' kahate haiṃ| isakā hindī artha 63 khambhoṃkā jaina mandira hotā hai| merā anumāna hai ki vaha mandira jainoṃkā prasiddha śāntimandira aura isake 63 khambha jainoṃke triṣaṣṭiśalākāpuruṣoṃkā smṛticihna honā cāhiye| mandira baḍa़ā puṣṭa hai aura vastutaḥ sarvocca kalākā eka pratīka hai| khambhoṃkā pāliśa itanā sundara hai ki itane dinoṃke bāda, āja bhī unameṃ āsānīse mukha dekha sakate haiṃ| mandira cāra khaṇḍoṃmeṃ vibhakta hai| garbhagṛha viśeṣa baḍa़ā nahīṃ hai| isake sāmanekā khaṇḍa garbhagṛhase baḍa़ā hai, tīsarā khaṇḍa isase baḍa़ā hai, antimakā caturtha khaṇḍa sabase baḍa़ā hai| itanā baḍa़ā hai ki usameṃ kaī sau ādamī ārāmase baiṭha sakate haiṃ| chata aura dīvāloṃ parakī sundara kalāpūrṇa mūrtiyā~ nirdaya vidhvaṃsakoṃke dvārā naṣṭa kī gaī haiṃ| isa mandirako dekhakara usa samaya kī kalā, ārthika sthiti aura dhārmika śraddhā ādiko āja bhī vivekī parakha sakatā hai| kheda hai ki baṃkāpura ādi sthānoṃke ina prācīna mahattvapūrṇa jaina sthānoṃkā uddhāra to dūra rahā, jaina samāja ina sthānoṃ ko jānatī bhī nahīṃ hai|
4. rāmakathākī vibhinna dhārāe~ padhnapurāṇa aura uttara purāṇakī rāma-kathāmeṃ paryāpta matabheda hai| yaha kyoṃ aura kaba huā isakā viśvasta rūpase kaha sakanā saṃbhava nahīṃ dikhatā| jaba logoṃko mālūma huā ki uttarapurāṇakā sampādana
aura anuvāda mere dvārā ho rahā hai taba kaī vidvānoṃne isa āśayake patra likhe ki āpa rāma-kathāke matabhedakī gutthī avaśya hī sulajhāiye | merī dṛṣṭi bhī isa ora bahuta samayase thī| parantu adhyayana karaneke bāda bhī maiṃ isa pariṇāma para nahīṃ pahuṃca sakā ki ākhira yaha matabheda kyoṃ aura kabase calā| rāmakathā kī vibhinna dhārāoṃ para prakāśa ḍālate hue śraddhaya śrīmān nāthūrāmajī premīne apane 'jaina sāhitya aura itihāsa, nāmaka granthameṃ prakāśita 'padmacarita aura pauma cariu, nāmaka lekhameṃ 'rāma kathā kī vibhinna dhārāe~' śīrṣaka eka prakaraṇa likhā hai jo ki isa viṣaya para paryāpta prakāśa ḍālatā hai| pāṭhakoṃkī jānakārī ke lie maiṃ use yahā~ lekhakake hī śabdoṃmeṃ uddhata kara denā ucita samajhatā hū~--
"rāmakathā bhāratavarṣakī sabase adhika lokapriya kathā hai aura isa para vipula sāhitya nirmāṇa kiyā gayā hai| hindū, bauddha aura jaina ina tīnoṃ hī prācīna sampradāyoṃ meṃ yaha kathā apane-apane ḍhaṃgase likhī gaī hai aura tīnoṃ hī sampradāyavāle rāmako apanā apanā mahāpuruṣa mānate haiṃ|
abhī taka adhikāṃśa vidvānoṃkā mata yaha hai ki isa kathāko sabase pahale vālmīki munine likhā aura saṃskṛtakā sabase pahalā mahākāvya (ādikāvya) vālmīki rāmāyaṇa hai| usake bāda yaha kathā mahābhārata, brahmapurāṇa, agnipurāṇa, vāyupurāṇa ādi sabhī purāṇoṃ meṃ thoḍa़e-thoḍa़e herapherake sātha saṃkṣepameṃ lipi baddha kī gaī hai| isake sivāya adhyātmarāmāyaṇa, ānandarāmāyaṇa, adbhuta rāmāyaṇa nāmase bhī kaī rāmāyaṇa grantha likhe gaye | vṛhattara bhāratake jāvā, sumātrā ādi deśoṃke sāhityameṃ bhī isakā aneka rūpāntaroṃ ke sātha vistāra huā|
adbhuta rāmāyaṇameṃ sītākī utpattikī kathā sabase nirālī hai| usameṃ likhā hai ki daṇḍakāraṇyameṃ gṛtsamada nāmake eka ṛṣi the| unakī strīne prārthanā kī ki mere garbhase sākṣāt lakṣmī utpanna ho| isa para usake lie ve pratidina eka ghaḍa़emeṃ dūdhako abhimantrita karake rakhane lage ki itane meṃ eka dina vahā~ rāvaṇa āyā aura usane ṛṣi para vijaya prāpta karaneke lie apane vāṇoṃkī noke cubhā-cubhākara unake śarīrakā būṃda-būṃda khūna nikālā aura use ghaḍa़e meṃ bhara diyā| phira vaha baḍa़ā usane mandodarīko jākara diyā aura cetā diyā ki yaha rakta viṣase bhī tīna hai| parantu mandodarī yaha socakara usa raktako pī gaī ki pati kā mujhapara saccā prema nahīṃ hai aura vaha nitya hī parastriyoṃmeṃ ramaṇa kiyā karatā hai, isalie aba merā mara jānā hī ṭhīka hai | parantu usake yogase vaha marī to nahīṃ, garbhavatī ho gaī| patikī anupasthitimeṃ garbha dhāraṇa ho jānese aba use chupānekā prayatna karane lagī aura ākhira eka dina vimānameṃ baiṭhakara kurukṣetra gaī aura usa garbhako jamīnameṃ gāḍa़kara vāpisa calī āī| usake bāda hala jotate samaya vaha garbhajāta kanyā janakajīko milī aura unhoṃne use pāla liyā vahī sītā hai|

rājā daśaratha kāśī deśameṃ vārāṇasīke rājā the | rāmakī mātākā nāma. subālā aura lakṣmaṇakī mātākā nāma kaikeyī thā| bharata śatrughna kisake garbhameṃ āye the, vaha spaṣṭa nahīṃ likhā| kevala 'kasyāṃ cit devyām' likha diyā | sītā mandodarīke garbhase utpanna huī thī, parantu bhaviṣyadvaktāoṃke yaha kahanese ki vaha nāśakāriṇī hai, rāvaṇane use maṃjūṣāmeṃ rakhavākara marīcike dvārā mithilā bhejakara jamīnameṃ gaḍa़vā diyā| daivayogase halakī nokameṃ ulajha jānese vaha rājā janakako mila gaī aura unhoṃne use apanī putrī ke rūpameṃ pāla lī| isake bāda jaba vaha vivāhake yogya huī, taba janakako cintā huī| unhoṃne eka vaidika yajña kiyā aura usakī rakṣāke lie rāma-lakṣmaṇako āgraha pūrvaka bulavāyā| phira rāmake sātha sītā ko vivāha diyā| yajñake samaya rāvaṇako āmaṃtraṇa nahīṃ bhejā gayā, isase vaha atyanta kra ho gayā aura isake bāda jaba nāradake dvārā usane sītāke rūpakī atiśaya praśaṃsā sunī taba vaha usako hara lānekī socane lagā|
kaikeyīke haṭha karane, rāmako vanavāsa dene ādikā isa kathāmeṃ koī jikra nahīṃ hai| paṃcavaṭī, daṇḍakavana, jaṭāyu, śūrpaṇakhā, kharadūṣaṇa ādike prasaṃgoṃkā bhī abhāva hai| banārasake pāsake hī citrakūṭa nāmaka vanase rāvaṇa sītāko hara le jātā hai aura phira usake uddhārake lie laṃkāmeṃ rāma-rāvaṇa yuddha hotā hai| rāvaṇako mārakara rāma digvijaya karate hue lauṭate haiṃ aura phira donoṃ bhāī banārasameṃ rājya karane lagate haiṃ| sītāke apavādakī aura usake kāraṇa use nirvāsita karanekī bhī carcā isameṃ nahīṃ hai| lakṣmaṇa eka asādhyarogameṃ grasita hokara mara jāte haiṃ aura isase rāmako udvega hotā hai| ve lakṣmaṇake putra pṛthvīsundara ko rājapada para aura sītāke putra ajitaṃjayako yuvarājapada para abhiṣeka karake aneka rājāoṃ aura apanī sītā ādi rāniyoṃke sātha jina-dīkṣā le lete haiṃ|

mahāpurāṇāntargata uttarapurāṇa
isameṃ sītāke āṭha putra batalāye, para unameṃ lava-kuśakā nāma nahīṃ hai| daśānana vinami vidyādhara ke vaṃśake pulastyakā putra thā | śatruoṃko satātā thā isa kāraṇa vaha rāvaṇa kahalāyā| ādi |
jahā~ taka maiṃ jānatā haiṃ. yaha uttarapurāṇakī rāmakathā śvetāmbara sampradāyameṃ pracalita nahīṃ hai| ācārya hemacandra ke triṣaṣṭiśalākā puruṣa caritameṃ jo rāmakathā hai, use maiṃne paḍha़ā| vaha bilakula 'paumacariya' kī kathāke anurūpa hai| aisā mālūma hotā hai ki 'paumacariya aura padmacarita donoṃ hī hemacandrā. cāryake sāmane maujūda the| jaisā ki pahale likhā jā cukā hai digambara sampradāyameṃ bhī isī kathākā adhika pracāra hai aura pīcheke kaviyoṃne to isī kathāko saṃkṣipta yā pallavita karake apane apane graṃtha likhe haiṃ| phira bhī uttarapurāṇakī kathā bilakula upekṣita nahīṃ huī | aneka kaviyoṃ ne usako bhī ādarśa mānakara kāvya racanā kī hai| udāharaṇake lie mahākavi puṣpadantako hī le lījiye| unhoṃne apane uttarapurāṇake antargata jo rāmāyaṇa likhī hai, vaha guṇabhadrakī kathākī hī anukṛti hai| cāmuṇḍarāyapurāṇameṃ bhī vahī kathā hai|
paumacariya aura padma caritakī kathākā adhikāṃśa vālmīki rāmāyaṇake ḍhaṃgakā hai aura uttarapurāṇa kī kathākā jānakī-janma adbhuta rāmāyaṇake ḍhaṃgakā| daśaratha banārasake rājā the yaha bāta bauddha jātakase milatī julatī hai| uttara purāṇake samāna usameṃ bhī sītā nirvāsana, lava-kuśa janma ādi nahīṃ hai|
arthāt bhāratavarṣa meṃ rāmakathākī jo do tīna paramparāe~ haiṃ, ve jaina sampradāyameṃ bhī prācīna kālase calī ā rahī haiṃ | paumacariuke kartāne kahā hai ki usa padmacaritako maiṃ kahatā hū~ jo ācāryoṃkī paramparāse calā ā rahā thā aura nāmāvalī nibaddha thā| isakā artha maiṃ yaha samajhatā hūṃ ki rāmacandrakā caritra usa samaya taka kevala nāmāvalīke rūpameṃ thā, arthāt usameṃ kathāke pradhāna pradhāna pātroṃke, unake mātā-pitāoṃ, sthānoṃ aura bhavāntaroṃ ādike nāma hī hoṃge, vaha pallavita kathāke rūpameṃ nahīṃ hogā aura usīkī vimala surine vistṛta racanāke rūpameṃ racanā kī hogī| śrī dharmasena gaṇīne vasudevahiṃḍike dūsare khaṇḍameṃ jo kucha kahā hai usase bhī yahī mālūma hotā hai ki unakā vasudevacarita bhī gaṇitānuyogake kramase nirdiṣṭa thā| usameṃ kucha śrutinibaddha thā aura kucha ācārya paramparāgata thā|
jaba vimalasūri pūrvokta nāmāvalīke anusāra apane granthakī racanāmeṃ pravṛta hue hoṃge taba aisā mālūma hotā hai ki unake sāmane avaśya hī koī lokapracalita rāmāyaṇa aisī rahī hogī jisameṃ rāvaṇādi ko rākṣasa, vasā-rakta-māṃsakā khāne pīnevālā aura kumbhakarṇako chaha chaha mahīne taka isa taraha sonevālā kahā hai ki parvata tulya hāthiyoṃke dvārā aṃga kucale jāne, kānoṃ meṃ ghaḍa़oṃ tela ḍāle jāne aura nagāḍa़e bajāye jāne para bhī vaha nahīṃ uṭhatā thā aura jaba uṭhatā thā to hāthī bhaiṃse ādi jo kucha sāmane pātā thā, saba nigala jātā thā| unakī yaha bhūmikā isa bātakā saṃketa karatī hai ki usa samaya vālmīki rāmāyaṇa yā usī jaisī rāma kathā pracalita thī aura usameṃ aneka alīka, upapattiviruddha tathā aviśvasanīya bāteṃ thīṃ, jinheṃ satya, sopapatika aura viśvāsa yogya banānekā vimalasūrine prayatna kiyā hai| jainadharmakā nāmāvalī nibaddha ḍhāṃcā unake samakṣa thā hī aura śruti paramparā yā ācārya paramparāse āyā huā kathāsūtra bhī thā | usīke ādhāra para unhoṃne paumacariyakī racanā kī hogī|

prācīna nahīṃ hai| hamārā anumāna hai ki guṇabhase bahuta pahale vimalasūrike hī samāna kisī anya ācārya ne bhī jainadharmake anukūla sopapattika aura viśvasanīya svatantra rūpase rāmakathā likhī hogī aura vaha guṇabhadrācāryako guruparamparā dvārā milī hogī | guṇabhadrake guru jinasena svāmīne apanā ādipurāṇa katri parameśvarakī gadya-kathāke ādhārase likhā thā- 'kaviparameśvaranigaditagadyakathāmātṛkaṃ purodharitam |' aura usake pichale kucha aṃśakī mūrti svayaṃ guṇabhaṭṭane bhī kī hai jinasena svāmīne kavi parameśvara yā pavi parameṣṭhīko 'vāgarthasaṃgraha' nāmaka samagra purāṇakā kartā batalāyā hai| ataeva munisuvrata tīrthaṃkarakā cā śrī guṇabhadra ne usīke ādhārase likhā hogā jisake antargata rāmakathā bhī hai | cāmuṇḍarāyane kavi parameśvarakā smaraṇa kiyā hai |
garaja yaha ki paumacariya aura udhara purāṇakī rāmakathākī do dhārāe~ alaga-alaga svatantra rūpase nirmita huī aura ve hī āge pravāhita hotī huī hama taka āī haiṃ | ina do dhārāoṃ meṃ guru-paramparā bheda bhī ho sakatā hai| eka paramparāne eka dhārāko apanāyā aura dūsarīne dūsarīko aisī daśā meṃ guṇabhadra svāmīne paumacariyakī dhārāse paricita hone para bhī isa khyālase usakā anusaraṇa na kiyā hogā ki vaha hamārī guruparamparākī nahīṃ hai| yaha bhī sambhava ho sakatā hai ki unheṃ paumacariyake kathānakakī apekṣā yaha kathānaka jyādā acchā mālūma huā ho |
paumacariyakī racanā vi0 saṃ0 20 meṃ huī hai aura yadi jaina dharma digambara śvetāmbara bhedoṃmeṃ vi0 saṃ0 136 ke lagabhaga hī vibhakta huā hai jaisā ki donoṃ sampradāyavāle mānate haiṃ, to phira kahanā hogā ki yaha usa samayakā hai jaba jaina dharma avibhakta thā| hameṃ isa grantha meṃ koī aisī bāta bhī nahīṃ milī jisa para domeṃ se kisī eka sampradāya kī gaharī chāpa lagī ho aura usase hama yaha nirṇaya kara sakeṃ ki vimala sūri anuka sampradāya ke hī the balki kucha bāteṃ aisī haiṃ jo śvetāmbara paramparāke viruddha jātī haiṃ aura kucha digambara paramparake viruddha | isase aisā mālūma hotā hai ki yaha eka tīsarī hī donoṃ ke bīca kī, vicāradhārā hai|
6. anya kathāoṃmeṃ bhī vividhatā
ikahatara parva meṃ balarāma, śrīkṛṣṇa, unakī āṭha rāniyā~ tathā prathamna ādike bhavāntara batalāye gaye haiṃ isameṃ jinasena [ dvitīya] ke harivaṃśapurāṇase kahīṃ-kahīṃ nāma tathā kathānaka ādimeṃ bheda pāyā jātā hai| isī prakāra pacahattaraveṃ parva meṃ jīvandhara svāmīkā carita likhā gayā hai parantu usameṃ aura ācārya bāḍa़īmasiṃhake dvārā likhita gadyacintāmaṇi yā kṣatracūḍāmaṇike kathānakameṃ kāphī vividhatā hai| nāma ādikavividhatā to hai hī para unake caritra-citraṇa meṃ bhī vividhatā hai| isakā kāraṇa yaha ho sakatā hai ki vādī mahine paurāṇika kathānakako kāmyake ḍhoṃcemeṃ ḍālaneke lie pariṣkṛta kiyā ho | ādi prakaraṇoṃko choḍa़ diyā ho | para pātroṃke nāma ādimeṃ bheda kaise ho gayā yaha samajhameṃ nahīṃ ātā | 7. mahāpurāṇakā parimāṇa
isa mahāpurāṇa pranthakā anuṣṭup ilokoṃkī saṃkhyā meṃ kitanā parimāṇa hai ? isake viṣaya meṃ do ullekha milate haiṃ- eka to guṇabhadrācāryane hī granthake anta meṃ 20 hajāra śloka pramāṇa batalāyā hai aura dūsarā usī śloka pāṭhāntara meṃ 24 hajāra śloka pramāṇa batalāyā gayā hai | ina do ullekhoṃ ko dekhakara vicāra āyā ki isakā eka bāra nirṇaya kara lenā hī ucita hogā| phalasvarūpa mahāpurāṇa prathama-dvitīya bhāga tathā uttara purāṇake ślokoṃkā nirṇaya nimna yantrase kiyā jātā hai-

anuvāda aura ābhāra-pradarśana utarapurāṇake pāṭha-bheda lene meṃ śrī paṃ0 kapūracandrajī āyurvedācārya, śrī lakṣmaṇaprasādajī 'praśānta' sāhityaśāstrī, māsṭara parameṣṭhīdāsajī vidyārthī, gokulacandrajī tathā vidyārthī rājendrakumārajī ādikā pūrṇa sahayoga prāpta huā hai| isalie ina sabakā ābhārī hūṃ| hastalikhita pratiyoṃke vācanameṃ śrīmān vayovṛddha paṃ0 lālārāmajī śāstrī dvārā anūdita evaṃ prakāśita uttarapurāṇase paryāpta sāhāyya prāpta huā hai| maiṃ unakā ābhāra mānatā hū~| prastāvanā lekhameṃ śrīmān nāthūrāmajī premī evaṃ paṃ. ke. bhujabalī śāhī mūḍabidrīke kramaśaḥ 'rāmakathākī vibhinna dhārāe~' aura 'baṃkāpurakā paricaya' śīṣarka prakaraṇa diye gaye haiṃ ataḥ | maiṃ inakā bhī ābhārī hū~ | isa granthake sampādana evaṃ anuvādameṃ do varṣakā lambā samaya laga gayā hai| dūravartī rahaneke kāraṇa maiṃ isakā prapha svayaṃ nahīṃ dekha sakā hū~ ataḥ paṃ0 mahādevajī caturvedī vyākaraṇācārya banārasane dekhā hai, merā dhyāna hai ki unhoṃne isa viṣayameṃ kāphī sāvadhānī rakhī hai| isakā prakāśana bhāratīya jñānapīṭha banārasakī orase huā hai ataḥ maiṃ usake saṃcālaka aura vyavasthāpaka mahānubhāvoṃ kā atyanta ābhārī hū~|
mahāpurāṇa, padmapurāṇa kaura harivaṃśapurāṇa ye tīna purāṇa,digambara jaina prathamānuyoga sāhityake anūṭhe ratna haiṃ | maiṃne inakā svādhyāya kaī bāra kiyā hai| manameṃ icchā hotī thī ki inakā ādhunika rūpase sampādana tathā anuvāda ho jāya to āma janatākā bahuta upakāra ho| ina tīna granthoṃ meṃ se mahāpurāṇakā sampādana aura anuvāda kara mujhe bahuta prasannatā huī hai| padmapurāṇa aura harivaṃśapurāṇake sampādana tathā anuvādakī āvaśyakatā avaśiṣṭa hai| dekhū usakī pūrti kaba hotī hai|

mahāpurāṇe uttarapurāṇam āyuṣo vasatiḥ kāye kāyasthasya mamāpyalam | āyurjalaṃ galatyāśu mitakālaghaṭītam || 9|| tato galati niḥśeṣa na yāvattāvadeva hi| vāmyutsadya sanmārge jaine svargāpavargayoḥ||10|| ityāśāpāśamācchidya bahubhiḥ saha nispṛhaḥ | rājalakṣmyā svatantro'pi dīkṣālakṣmyā vaśīkṛtaḥ||7|| tapasyan sucira tī vispaṣṭaikādaśāṅgakaḥ | nāmno'ntyameṣa puṇyātmā svakārṣījhāvanāparaḥ || 12|| āyuṣo'nte samādhāna vidhāya parameṣṭhiṣu | trayaviṃśatsamudrāyurayāt sa 4vijayaṃ jayī||13|| tatrādāyādyasaṃsthānaṃ "śuklaleśyādvayānvitaḥ | hastocchrārya śubhaṃ dehaṃ suvarṇādicatuṣṭayam || 14 || māsaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pañcadaśabhiśvocchavasan dinaiḥ | trayastriṃśatsahasābdai nisāhāramāharan || 15 || nijatejo'vadhivyātalokanālinijāvadhiḥ | kṣetrotthāpibalastatpūrakakāyajavikriyaḥ || 16 || sātapañcaśubhaiḥ saukhyamapravīcāramanvabhūt | sapravīcārasatsaukhyāttadanantaguṇādhikam || 17 || tasmānmahīṃ 'mahābhāge svargādvorāgamiṣyati | prāgeva bhāvanopāttatīrthakṛnnāmapuṇyataḥ || 18 || dvīpe'smin bhārate varṣe sāketanagarādhipaḥ | ikṣvākurjitaśavākhyaḥ khyāto gotreṇa kāśyapaḥ || 19|| tasya śakrājñayā gehe ṣaṇmāsān pratyahaṃ muhuḥ | ravānyailavila stisraḥ koṭīḥ sārdha nyapīpatat ||20|| jyeṣṭhe māsi kalāśeṣaśaśirohiṇyupāgame | muhūrtād brahmaṇaḥ pūrva °daranidrāvilekṣaṇām || 21 ||

isa prakāra āśārūpī pāśako chedakara vaha rājā rājyalakṣmīse nispṛha ho gayā tathā svādhīna honepara bhī aneka rājāoṃke sātha dīkṣārūpī lakṣmīke dvārā apane ādhīna kara liyā gayā arthāt aneka rājāoṃke sātha usane jina-dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī || 11 || jisane bahuta samaya taka tīna tapasyā kī hai, jise gyāraha aṅgoṃkā spaṣṭa jñāna ho gayā hai, jisakī ātmā puṇyake prakāśase jagamagā rahī hai aura jo darśanaviśuddhi ādi solaha bhāvanāoṃke cintanameṃ nirantara tatpara rahatā hai aise isa vimalavāhanane tīrthaṃkara nāmakamakā bandha kiyā ||12|| indriyoṃpara vijaya prāpta karanevālā vaha vimalavāhana āyuke anta samaya pañcaparameṣṭhiyoṃmeṃ citta sthirakara-samādhimaraṇa kara taiṃtīsa sāgarakī āyukā dhāraka ho vijaya nāmaka anuttaravimānameṃ pahu~cā ||13|| vahā~ vaha dravya
aura bhāva donoṃ hī śuklaleśyāoṃse sahita thā tathā samacaturastrasaṃsthānase yukta eka hātha ū~ce evaṃ praśasta rūpa, rasa, gandha, sparśase sampanna śubha śarīrako lekara utpanna huā thā, solaha mahīne aura pandraha dina bāda ucchvāsa letā thā, taiṃtīsa hajāravarṣa bāda mānasika āhāra grahaṇa karatā thā, usane apane avadhijñānake dvārā lokanāḍa़īko vyāpta kara rakhā thā arthāt lokanāḍa़ī paryantake rūpī padārthoṃko vaha apane avadhijñānase dekhatā thā, usameṃ lokanāḍa़īko ukhāḍa़kara dūsarī jagaha rakha denekī śakti thī, vaha utane hī kṣetra meṃ apane śarīrakī vikriyā bhī kara sakatā thā aura sukhasvarūpa paṃcendriyoṃ ke dvārā pravīcārajanya sukhase anantaguṇā adhika apravīcāra sukhakā upabhoga karatā thā || 14-17 || usa mahābhāgake svargase pṛthivīpara avatāra leneke chaha māha pūrvase hī pratidina tīrthakara nāmaka puṇyaprakṛtike prabhāvale jambūdvīpake bharatakṣetrake adhipati ikṣvākuvaṃśīya kāśyapagotrī rājā jitaśatruke gharameṃ indrakī ājñāse kuberane sāḍha़e tīna karoḍa़ ranoṃkī vṛṣṭi kī|| 18-20 || tadanantara jeṭha mahīnekī amāvasake dina jabaki rohiṇī nakṣatrakā kalā mātrase avaśiṣṭa candramāke sātha

maṇiketuke isa prakāra kahane para vaha cakravartī saṃsārase bhayabhīta to huā parantu mokṣamārgako prāpta nahīṃ kara sakā kyoki putrarūpī saॉkalose majabūta baṃdhā huā thā|64||'abhī isakā saṃsāra bahuta baḍa़ā hai| isa prakāra viṣāda karatā huā maṇiketu calā gayā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki niṣphala upāya kisa buddhimānako viṣāda nahīṃ karatā ? ||65|| vaha deva socane lagā ki dekho sāmrājyakī tuccha lakṣmīse vaśībhūta hue cakravartīne acyuta svargakī lakṣmī bhulā dī so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki kāmī manuṣyoṃko acche-bure padārthoṃke antarakā jñāna kahā~ hotā hai ? ||66|| mujhe to aisā jāna paḍa़tā hai ki yaha cakravartī saba lābhoṃmeṃ putra-lābhako hī lābha mānatā hai, svarga aura mokṣalakṣmīkā lābha isake lie lābha nahīṃ hai, aisā samajhakara hī yaha putroṃmeṃ atyanta līna ho rahā hai ||7||

ekapañcāśattama parva
lakṣmīranaśvarī teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ tasya mate matiḥ | deyādādeyavā sadbhiḥ so'smabhyaṃ sumatimaṃtim ||1|| akhaṇḍe dhātakīkhaṇḍe mandare prāci pūrvage | videhe nayudakkūle surāṣṭra puṣkalāvatī || 2 || pure'smin puṇḍarīkiyāṃ ratiṣeṇo mahīpatiḥ| prāgjanmopārjitodīrṇapuṇyapaṇyātmasāskṛtam ||3|| rājyaṃ vinirjitārātiniḥkopaṃ nityavṛddhikam | svāmisampatsametaḥ sannītyā nirvyasano'nvabhūt || 4|| "yā svasyaivāsya sā vidyā caturthī na prayogiṇī | yadekasyāpi daṇḍeṣu vartante na pathi prajāḥ ||5|| raktasya manasā tṛptiḥ kāmaḥ karaṇagocare | sveṣṭāśeṣārthasampatteḥ kāmastasya na durlabhaḥ || 6|| arthe catuṣṭayī vṛttirarjanādi yathāgamam | devo'hanarthadharmoṃ ca tadanīṣallabhī matī ||7|| gacchatyevaṃ ciraṃ kāle helayā pālitakṣiteḥ | parasparānukūlyena vargatritayavadinaḥ ||8||
jantoḥ kiṃ kuśalaṃ kasmātsukhameṣo'dhitiṣṭhati | paryāyāvartadurjanmadurmṛtyaragadūragaḥ ||9|| - na tāvadakāmābhyāṃ sukhaṃ saṃsāravarddhanāt | nāmuṣmādapi me dharmācasmātsāvāsambhavaḥ || 10 ||
athānantara jo loga sumatināthakī buddhiko hī buddhi mānate haiṃ athavā unake dvārā pratipādita matameṃ hī jinakī buddhi pravṛtta rahatī hai unheṃ avināśī lakṣmīkī prāpti hotī hai| isake sivāya jinake vacana sajjana puruṣoṃke dvārā grāhya haiṃ aise sumatinātha bhagavān hama sabake lie sadbuddhi pradāna kareṃ ||1|| akhaṇḍa dhātakīkhaṇḍa dvīpameṃ pūrva meruparvatase pūrvakī ora sthita videha kṣetrameṃ sītā nadīke uttara taṭa para eka puṣkalāvatī nāmakā uttama deśa hai ||2|| usakī puṇḍarīkiṇī nagarīmeṃ ratiṣeṇa nāmakā rājā thā| vaha rājā rāja-sampadāoṃse sahita thā, use kisī prakārakā
jata viśāla puṇyakarmake udayase prāpta hue rājyakā nīti-pūrvaka upabhoga karatā thā| usakā vaha rājya śatruoṃ se rahita thā, krodhake kāraṇoṃse rahita thā aura nirantara vṛddhiko prāpta hotā rahatā thā ||3-4|| rājā ratiṣeṇakī jo rājavidyā thī vaha usī kī thī vaisī rājavidyā anya rājāoṃmeṃ nahīṃ pāī jātī thī| ānvīkṣikī, trayī, vārtā aura daṇḍa ina cāroṃ vidyāoṃmeṃ cauthī daṇḍāvadyākā vaha kabhī prayoga nahīṃ karatā thā kyoṃki usakī prajā prāṇadaṇḍa ādi aneka daṇḍoṃmeṃse kisī eka bhī daṇḍake mārgameṃ nahīṃ jātī thī||5|| indriyoṃ ke viṣayameṃ anurāga rakhanevāle manuṣyako jo mānasika tṛpti hotī hai use kāma kahate haiṃ| vaha kāma, apane iṣṭa samasta padārthokī saṃpatti rahanese rājā ratiṣaṇako kucha bhī durlabha nahīṃ thā ||6|| vaha rājā arjana, rakṣaṇa, vardhana aura vyaya ina cāroṃ upāyāse dhana saṃcaya karatā thā aura āgamake anusāra praha hī deva mānatā thā| isa prakāra artha aura dharmako vaha kāmakī apekṣā sulabha nahīṃ mānatā thā arthāta kāmakī apekṣā artha tathā dharma puruṣārthakā adhika sevana karatā thā ||7||isa prakāra līlāpūrvaka pṛthivīkā pālana karanevāle aura parasparakī anukūlatāse dharma, artha, kāma isa trivargakī vṛddhi karanevāle rājā ratiṣaṇakā jaba bahuta-sā samaya vyatīta ho gayā taba eka dina usake hṛdayameṃ nimnāṅkita vicāra utpanna huā || 8|| vaha vicāra karane lagā ki isa saṃsārameṃ jīvakā kalyāṇa karanevālā kyā hai ?
aura paryāyarūpī bha~varāmeṃ rahanevāle durjanma tathā durmaraṇa rūpī sā~se dūra rahakara yaha jīva sukhako kisa prakāra prāpta kara sakatā hai ? artha aura kāmase to sukha ho nahīṃ sakatā kyoṃki unase saṃsārakī hī vṛddhi hotī hai | rahā dharma, so jisa dharmameṃ pāpakī saṃbhāvanā hai usa dharmase bhī sukha nahīṃ ho

|| 44 || ghātiyā karmoṃke naṣṭa hone para isake kevalajñānarūpī upayogameṃ jaba taka sārā saṃsāra nahīṃ jhalakane lagatā taba taka mithyātva ādise dūṣita indriyoṃke viṣayoṃse ise tṛpti nahīṃ ho sakatī || 45 || yaha śarīra rogarūpī sā~poṃkī vāmī hai tathā yaha jīva dekha rahā hai ki hamāre iṣṭajana inhīṃ rogarūpī sā~poṃse kāṭe jākara naṣṭa ho rahe haiṃ phira bhī yaha śarīrameṃ avināśī moha kara rahā hai yaha baḍa़ā āścarya hai| kyā āja taka kahīṃ kisī jīvane śrāyuke sātha sahavāsa kiyā hai ? arthāt nahīṃ kiyā ||46-47|| jo hiṃsādi pā~ca pāpoṃko dharma mānatā hai, aura indriya tathā padārthake sambandhase honevāle sukhako sukha samajhatā hai usī viparītadaśī manuṣyake lie yaha saṃsāra rucatā hai-acchā māra ||48|| jisa kāryase pāpa aura puṇya donoṃ upalepoṃkā nāśa ho jātā hai, vidvānoṃko sadā usīkā dhyāna karanā cāhiye, usīkā ācaraṇa karanā cāhiye aura usīkā adhyayana karanā cāhiye || 46 || isa prakāra saṃsāra, śarīra aura bhoga ina tīnoṃke vairāgyase jinheṃ ātmajñāna utpanna huā hai, laukāntika deveāṃne jinakā utsāha baḍha़āyā hai aura caturnikāya devoṃne jinake dīkṣā-kalyāṇakakā abhiṣekotsava kiyā hai aise bhagavān padmaprabha. nivṛtti nāmakī pālakī para savāra hokara manohara nāmake vanameṃ gaye aura vahā~ velākā niyama lekara kārtika kṛṣṇa trayodaśīke dina śāmake samaya citrā nakṣatrameṃ eka hajāra rājāoṃke sātha ādara pūrvaka unhoṃne śikṣāke samāna dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī ||50-52|| jinheṃ manaḥparyayajñāna utpanna ho gayā hai aise vidvānoṃmeṃ śreṣṭha padmaprabha svāmī dūsare dina caryāke lie vadhemāna nāmaka nagarameṃ praviṣṭa hue||53|| śukla kāntike dhāraka rājā sāmadattane unheṃ dāna dekara pañcāścarya prāpta kiye so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki pātradānase kyā nahīṃ hotā hai ? catuḥpañcāśattama parva nītvaikavarṇatāṃ 1sā sabhāṃ yaḥ prabhayā svayā| śuddhitāmanayacchuddhaḥ śuddhaya candraprabho'stu naḥ ||1|| dehaprabheva vāgyasyāhlādinyapi ca bodhinī | sāmāmi nabhobhāge suratārāpariṣkṛtam || 2|| nāmagraho'pi yasyārgha nihantyakhilamaṅginām | na hanyāt kiṃ nu tasyāyaṃ caritaṃ śrutigocaram || 3 || tatpurāṇaṃ tato vakṣye bhavādāsaptamādaham | śrotavyaṃ bhavya te śraddhā nidhāya magadhādhipa || 4 || dānaṃ pūjāṃ tathānyaśca muktyai jñānena saṃskṛtam | tatpurāṇaśruteḥ śravyaṃ tattadeva hitaiṣibhiḥ || 5|| arha nirbhāṣitaṃ sūktamanuyogaiśvasuṣṭayam | teṣu pūrva purāṇāni tasmātproktaḥ śrutikramaḥ || 6 || sā jihvā tau manaḥkarṇī yairvaktiśruticintanāḥ | pūrvādīnāṃ purāṇānāṃ puruṣārthopadeśinām || 7 || astyatra puṣkaradvīpaḥ tanmadhye mānuṣottaraḥ | 'nṛsaṃcārasya sīmāsau sarvato valayākṛtiḥ ||8|| tadabhyantarabhāge sto mandarau pūrvapaścimau | pūrvasmin mandare deśo videhe paścime mahān || 9|| sītododaktaṭe durgavanakhanyākarocitaiḥ | akṛṣṭapacyasasyāyaiḥ sugandhibhūguṇairabhāt ||10|| tasmindeśe janāḥ sarve varṇatrayavikalpitāḥ| snigdhāḥ sūkṣmekṣaṇāḥ prekṣyā vilocanaviśeṣavat ||11|| ṛjavo dhārmikā bītadoṣāḥ kleśasahiṣṇavaḥ | karṣakāḥ saphalārambhāḥ tapaḥsthāścātiśerate ||12||
jo svayaṃ śuddha haiṃ aura jinhoṃne apanī prabhāke dvārā samasta sabhāko eka varṇakī banākara śuddha kara dī. ve candraprabha svāmī hama sabakī śuddhike lie hoṃ||| 1|| śarīrakī prabhāke samāna jinakī vāṇī bhī harṣita karanevālī tathā padārthoṃko prakāśita karanevālī thī aura jo ākāśameṃ devarūpī tārāoṃse ghire rahate the una candraprabha svāmīko namaskāra karatā hū~||2|| jinakā nāma lenā bhī jīvoṃke samasta pāpoṃko naṣṭa kara detā hai phira sunā huā unakā pavitra caritra kyoṃ nahīṃ naṣṭa kara degā ? isalie maiṃ pahaleke sāta bhavāṃse lekara unakā caritra kahūṃgā| he bhavya śreṇika ! tujhe use śraddhā rakhakara sunanā cāhiye || 3-4 || dāna, pūjā tathā anya kāraṇa yadi samyagjñānase suśobhita hote haiṃ to ve muktike kāraṇa hote haiṃ aura cū~ki vaha samyagjñāna isa purāṇake sunanese hotā hai. ataḥ hitakī icchā karanevāle puruṣoṃke dvārā avaśya hī sunaneke yogya hai || 5|| arhanta bhagavānne anuyogeāṃke dvārā jo cāra prakārake sūkta batalāye haiṃ unameṃ purāṇa prathama sūkta hai ! bhagavānne ina purāṇāṃse hī sunanekā krama batalāyā hai || 6||
dharma, artha, kāma aura mokṣa puruṣārthakā upadeśa denevāle bhagavāna ṛṣabhadeva ādike purāṇoṃko jo jībha kahatī hai, jo kāna sunate haiṃ aura jo mana socatā hai vahī jībha hai, vahī kāna hai aura vahī mana hai, anya nahīṃ|| 7 ||

hai || 36 || karma puṇyarūpa hoṃ athavā na hoṃ, yadi karma vidyamāna haiṃ to unase isa jīvako sukha kaise mila sakatā hai ? kyoṃki yaha jīva rāga-dveṣa tathā abhilāṣā ādi aneka doṣoṃse yukta hai ||40|| yadi viṣayoṃse hī sukha prāpta hotā hai to maiṃ viṣayoṃke antako prāpta hū~ arthāt mujhe sabase adhika sukha prāpta haiṃ phira mujhe saṃtoṣa kyoṃ nahīṃ hotā| isase jāna paḍa़tā hai ki viṣaya-sambandhī sukha mithyā sukha hai || 41 || udāsīnatā hī saccā sukha hai aura vaha udāsīnatā mohake rahate hue kaise ho sakatī hai ? isalie maiṃ sarvaprathama isa moha śatruko hī śīghratāke sātha jaḍa़-mūlase naṣṭa karatā hū~||42|| isa prakāra padārthake yathārtha svarūpakā vicāra kara unhoṃne vivekiyoṃke dvārā choḍa़neke yogya aura mohī jīvoṃke dvārā ādara deneke yogya apanā sārā sāmrājya putrake lie de diyā| ||43|| usī samaya āye hue laukāntika devoṃne jinakī stuti kī hai tathā unhoṃne dīkṣā-kalyāṇaka pūjā prāpta kī hai aise bhagavān śītalanātha śukraprabhā nāmakī pālakī para savāra hokara sahetuka vanameṃ pahu~ce||44|| vahā~ unhoṃne māghakṛṣṇa dvādaśīke dina sāyaṃkālake samaya pūrvāṣāḍha़ā nakṣatra meṃ do upavāsakā niyama lekara eka hajāra rājāoṃke sātha saṃyama dhāraṇa kiyā || 45 || cāra jñānake dhārī bhagavāna dasare dina caryā ke lie ariṣṭa nagarameṃ praviṣṭa hue| vahā~ navadhā bhakti karanevāle punarvasu rājāne baḍa़e harṣake sātha unheṃ khīrakā āhāra dekara saṃtuṣṭa devoṃke dvārā pradatta pañcāścarya prāpta kiye ||46-47|| tadanantara chāstha avasthāke tīna varṣa bitākara ve eka dina belake vṛkṣake nīce do dinake upavāsakā niyama lekara virājamāna hue| jisase pauṣakṛṣṇa caturdaśīke dina pūrvāṣāḍha़ nakṣatrameṃ sāyaṃkālake samaya suvarṇake samāna kāntivāle una bhagavānane kevalajñāna prāpta kiyā| usī samaya devoṃne ākara unake jñāna-kalyāṇakakī pūjā kī || 45-46 || unakī sabhāmeṃ sapta ṛddhiyoṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle anagāra

jo vāsu arthāt indra ke pūjya haiṃ athavā mahārāja vasupūjyake putra haiṃ aura sajjana loga jinakī pūjā karate haiṃ aise vāsupūjya bhagavān apane jñānase hama sabako pavitra kareṃ||1|| puṣkarārdha dvīpake pūrva merukī ora sītā nadīke dakṣiṇa taṭa para vatsakāvatī nāmakā eka deśa hai| usake atiśaya prasiddha ranapura nagarameṃ padmottara nāmakā rājā rājya karatā thā ||2|| usa rājākī guṇamayī kīrti sabake vacanoṃmeṃ rahatī thī, puṇyamayī mūrti sabake netroṃmeṃ rahatī thī, aura dharmamayī vṛtti sabake cittameṃ rahatī thī ||3|| usake vacanoṃmeṃ śānti thī, cittameṃ dayā thī, śarīrameṃ teja thā, buddhimeṃ nīti thī, dānameṃ dhana thā, jinendra bhagavānmeṃ bhakti thī aura śatruoṃmeṃ pratāpa thā arthāt apane pratāpase śatruoṃko naṣṭa karatā thā ||4|| jisa prakāra nyāyamārgase calanevāle munimeṃ samitiyā~ baḍha़tī rahatī haiṃ usī prakāra nyāyamārgase calanevāle usa rājāke prathivīkā pālana karate samaya prajā khūba baḍha़ rahī thī||5|| usake guṇa hī dhana thā tathā usakī lakṣmī bhī guṇoṃse prema karanevālī thī isalie vaha usa lakṣmīke sātha binā kisī pratibandhake viśāla sukha prāpta karatā rahatā thā || 6|| kisī eka dina manohara nāmake parvata para yugandhara jinarāja virājamāna the| padmottara rājāne vahā~ jākara bhaktipūrvaka aneka stotroṃse unakī upāsanā kī||7|| vinayapūrvaka dharma sunā aura anuprekṣāoṃkā cintavana kiyā | anuprekṣāoṃke cintavanase use saṃsāra, śarīra aura bhogose tīna prakārakā vairāgya utpanna ho gayā| vairāgya hone para vaha isa prakāra punaḥ cintavana karane lagā||8|| ki yaha lakṣmī māyā rūpa hai, sukha duḥkharūpa hai, jīvana maraṇa paryanta hai, saṃyoga-viyoga hone taka hai aura yaha duṣṭa śarīra rogoṃse sahita hai ||6|| ataḥ ina sabameṃ kyā prema karanā hai ? aba to maiṃ upasthita huī isa kālalabdhikā avalambana lekara atyanta bhayānaka isa saṃsāra rūpī paśca parāvartanoṃse bāhara nikalatā hū~||10|| aisā vicāra kara usane rājyakā bhāra dhanamitra nāmaka putrake lie sopā aura svayaṃ ātma-śuddhike lie aneka rājāoṃke sātha lī|| 11|| nirmala buddhike dhāraka padmottara munine gyāraha aṃgoṃkā adhyayana kiyā, darśanaviśuddhi

dharme yasmin samudbhatā dharmā daśa sunirmalāḥ | sa dharmaḥ śarma me dadyādadharmamapahatya naḥ ||1|| dhātakīkhaṇḍaprāgbhāge prāgvidehe saritaṭe | dakṣiṇe vatsaviṣaye susīmānagaraṃ mahat || 2|| patirdaśarathastasya prajñāvikramadaivavān | svavaśīkṛtasāriḥ nirvyāyāmaḥ same sthitaḥ ||3|| sukhāni dharmasārāṇi prajāpālanalālasaḥ | bandhubhiśca suhṛdbhiśva saha viśrabdhamanvabhūt || 4|| mādhave śuklapakṣānte sampravṛttajanotsave | candroparāgamālokya sadyo niviṇṇamānasaḥ || 5|| kāntaḥ kuvalayālādī kalābhiḥ paripūrṇavān | īśasyāpi cedīhagavasthā'nyasya kā gatiḥ || 6|| iti matvā sute rājyabhāra kṛtvā mahārathe | naiḥsaṅgyāllāghavopetamaṅgīkṛtya sa saṃyamam || 7|| ekādaśāṅgadhārī san bhāvitadvayaṣṭakāraṇaḥ | nibaddhatīrthakṛtpuṇyaḥ svārādhyānte viśuddhīḥ ||8|| trayastriṃśatsamudrāyuḥ ekahastatanūcchṛitiḥ | pañcarandhracaturmānadinairucchvāsavān manāka || 9|| lokanālyantaravyāpivimalāvadhibodhanaḥ | tatkṣetravikriyātejobalasampatsamanvitaḥ ||10|| trisahasrādhikatriṃśatsahasrābdaiḥ samāharan | muhūrte mānasāhāraṃ śukkuleśyādvayaściram || 11 || sarvārthasiddhau satsaukhyaṃ niḥpravīcāramanvabhūt | tato nṛlokametasmin puṇyabhājyāgamiṣyati || 12|| dvīpe'sminbhārate ratnapurādhīśo mahīpateḥ | kuruvaṃśasya gotreṇa kāśyapasya mahaujasaḥ|| 13 || devyā bhānumahārājasaṃjñasya vipulaśriyaḥ| suprabhāyāḥ surānītavasudhārādisampadaḥ ||14||
jina dharmanātha bhagavānase atyanta nirmala uttamakṣamā ādi daśa dharma utpanna hue ve dharmanātha bhagavāna hamalogoṃkā adharma dūra kara hamāre lie sukha pradāna kareṃ ||1|| pūrva dhātakīkhaṇḍa dvīpake pūvevideha kṣetrameṃ nadīka dakṣiṇa taṭa para eka vatsa nāmakā deśa hai| usameṃ susīmā nāra hai ||2|| vahā~ rājā daśaratha rājya karatā thā, vaha buddhi, bala aura bhāgya tīnoṃse sahita thā| cū~ki usane samasta śatru apane vaśa kara liye the isalie yuddha ādike udyogase rahita hokara vaha śānti rahatā thā ||3|| prajākī rakṣā karanemeṃ sadā usakī icchā rahatī thī aura vaha bandhuoṃ tathā mitroṃke sātha niścintatāpūrvaka dharma-pradhāna sukhakā upabhoga karatā thā ||4|| eka bāra vaiśākha śukla pūrṇimā ke dina sabaloga utsava manā rahe the usī samaya candra grahaṇa paḍa़ā use dekhakara rājā daśarathakā mana bhogoṃse ekadama udāsa ho gayā ||5|| yaha candramā sundara hai, kuvalayoṃ-nīlakamaloṃ ( pakṣameṃmahīmaṇḍala ) ko ānandita karanevālā hai aura kalāoṃse paripūrṇa hai| jaba isakī bhī aisī avasthā huī hai taba anya puruṣakī kyā avasthā hogī ||6||aisā mānakara usane mahāratha nāmaka putrake lie rājyabhāra sauṃpā aura svayaṃ parigraharahita honese bhārahīna hokara saṃyama dhāraṇa kara liyā || 7 || usane gyāraha aṅgoṃkā adhyayana kara solaha kāraṇa-bhāvanāoṃkā cintavana kiyā, tīrthakara nāmaka puṇya prakṛtikā bandha kiyā aura āyuke antameṃ samādhimaraṇa kara apanī buddhiko nirmala banāyā
| aba vaha sarvārthasiddhimeṃ ahamindra huā, taiṃtīsa sāgara usakī sthiti thī, eka hātha ū~cā usakā śarīra thā, cāra sau ninyānaveṃ dina athavā sāḍha़e solaha māhameṃ eka bāra kucha śvāsa letā thā ||6|| loka nāḍa़īke anta taka usake nirmala avadhijñānakā viṣaya thā, utanī hī dūra taka phalanevālī vikriyā teja tathā balarūpa sampattise sahita thā || 10|| tīsa hajāra varṣameṃ eka bāra mānasika
āhāra letā thā, dravya aurabhāva sambandhī donoṃ śuklaleśyāoṃse yukta thā||11|| isaprakāra vaha sarvārthasiddhimeṃ pravīcāra rahita uttama sukhakā anubhava karatā thā| vaha puṇyaśālī jaba vahā~ se cayakara manuṣya lokameṃ janma leneke lie tatpara huā | 12 || taba isa jambūdvīpake bharatakṣetrameṃ eka ratnapura nāmakā nagara thā usameṃ kuruvaṃśī kāśyapagotrī mahātejasvī aura mahālakṣmīsampanna mahārāja bhānu rājya karate the unakī mahādevīkā nāma suprabhā thā, devoṃne ratnavṛṣṭi ādi sampadāoṃke dvārā usakā sammāna

athavā ayogya he ?? isa prakāra mhī huī bātakā acchī taraha vicāra kara sakatā ho, avasara para ayogya bātake doṣa kaha sakatā ho, uttama bātako bhaktiple grahaṇa karatā ho, upadeśaśravaṇake pahale grahaṇa kiye hue asāra upadeśameṃ jo viśeṣa ādara athavā haṭha nahīṃ karatā ho, bhūla ho jāne para jo ha~sī nahīṃ karatā ho, gurubhakta ho, kṣamāvān ho, saṃsārase ḍaranevālā ho, kahe hue vacanoṃko dhāraṇa karane meṃ tatpara ho, totā miṭṭī athavā haṃsake guṇoṃse sahita ho vaha śrotā kahalātā hai|| 8-10|| jisameṃ jīva ajīva ādi padārthoṃkā acchī taraha nirūpaṇa kiyā jātā ho, hitecchu manuṣyoṃko śarīra, saṃsāra aura bhogoṃse vairāgya prāpta karāyā jātā ho, dāna pūjā tapa aura śīlakī viśeṣatāe~ viśeṣatāke sātha batalāī jātī hoṃ. jīvoṃke lie bandha. mokṣa tathā unake phaloṃkā pṛthaka-pṛthaka varṇana kiyā jātā ho, jisameṃ sat aura asatkī kalpanā yuktise kī jātī ho, jahā~ mātāke samāna hita karanevālī dayākā khūba varṇana ho aura jisake sunanese prāṇī sarvapari.

vakareke donoṃ kāna kāṭakara pitāke pāsa vāpasa ā gayā aura kahane lagā ki he pūjya ! āpane jaisā kahā thā maiṃne vaisā hī kiyā hai| isaprakāra dayāhīna parvatane baḍa़e harṣale apanā kārya pūrṇa karanekī sūcanā pitāko dī ||308-306 || nārada bhī vanameṃ gayā aura socane lagā ki 'adṛśya sthānameṃ jākara isake kāna kāṭanā hai' aisā gurujīne kahā thā parantu yahā~ adṛśya sthāna hai hī kahā~ ? avasthāke rūpameṃ thā, vaha bahuta-sī bali arthāt śarīrakī sikuḍa़noṃko dhāraṇa kara rahā thā ve sikuḍa़ne aisī jāna paḍa़tī thīṃ māno yamarājake caḍha़neke lie sīdiyoṃkā mārga hī ho| andhekī taraha vaha bārabāra laḍa़khaḍa़ākara gira paḍa़tā thā, usake śira para virale virale sapheda bāla the, vaha eka sapheda raṅgakī pagaḍa़ī dhāraṇa kara rahā thā jisase aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno yamarājake bhayase usane cā~dīkā ṭopa hī lagā rakkhā ho, usake netra kucha-kucha banda the jisase aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno vṛddhāvasthā rūpī strīke samāgamase utpanna hue sukhase hī usake netra banda ho rahe the, usakī gati sūṃḍa़ kaṭe hue hāthīke samāna thī, vaha kruddha sā~pake samāna lambī-lambī śvāsa bhara rahā thā, rājāke pyāre manuṣyake samāna vaha madase āge nahīṃ dekhatā thā, usakī pīṭha ṭūṭī huī thī| vaha spaṣṭa nahīṃ bola sakatā thā, jisa prakāra rājā yogya daṇḍase sahita hotā hai arthāt sabake lie yogya daṇḍa-sajā detā hai usī prakāra . vaha bhī yogya daṇḍase sahita thā-arthāt apane anukūla daṇḍa-lāṭhī liye hue thā, ūparase itanā śānta dikhatā thā māno śarīradhārī śama-śānti hī ho, viśvabhū mantrī, sagara rājā aura sulasā kanyāke ūpara hamārā baira ba~dhā huā hai yaha kahaneke lie hī māno vaha tīna laḍa़ kā yajñopavīta dhāraṇa kara rahā thā, vaha apanā abhiprāya siddha karaneke lie yogya kāraṇa khoja rahā thā| aise mahākālane parvata para ghūmate hue kṣīrakadambakake putra parvatako dekhā| brāhmaṇa veṣadhārī mahākālane parvatake sammukha jākara use namaskāra kiyā aura parvatane bhī usakā abhivādana kiyā || 336-343 || mahākālane āśvāsana dete hue śrādarake sātha kahā ki tumhārā bhalā ho| tadanantara ajāna banakara mahākālane parvatase pūchā ki tuma kahā~se āye ho aura isa vanake madhyameṃ tumhārā bhramaṇa kisa kāraṇase ho rahā hai ? purāhitaḥ punaścāsau tatkathāṃ śrotumarhasi | iti sambodhya bhūpālaṃ tato vaktuṃ pracakrame ||1|| krameṇa śravyaśabdārthasāravāṇirbhavāvalīm | daśāsyasya daśāśāsyaprakāśisvayaśaḥśriyaḥ || 2|| athāsti nākalokābho dhātakīkhaṇḍapūrvabhāga | bhārate bhūguṇairyuko deśaḥ sārasamuccayaḥ || 3 || tasminnāgapure khyāto naradevo mahīpatiḥ | sa kadācidanantākhyagaṇeśātkṛtavandanaḥ || 4 || śrutadharmakatho jātanirvedo jyeṣṭhasūnave | pradāya bhogadevāya rājyamāpanasaṃyamaḥ || 5|| caraṃstapaḥ samutkṛṣṭaṃ raṣṭvā vidyādharādhipam | sadyaścapalavegākhyaṃ nidānamakarodadhīḥ || 6|| prānte saṃnyasya saudharmakalpe'bhūdamṛtāśanaḥ | athāsminbhārate kṣetre vijayāīmahācale || 7 || khageśo dakṣiṇaśreṇyāṃ meghakūṭapurādhipaḥ | vinamyanvayasambhūtaḥ sahasragrīvakhecaraḥ || 8|| ṛdhātmabhātṛputrorubalenotsāditastataḥ | gatvā laṅkāpuraṃ' triṃśatsahasrābdānyapālayat ||9|| tasya putraḥ śatagrīvastatṣaḍaṃśonavatsarān | pāti sma tatsutaḥ pañcāśagrīvopyanvapālayat ||10|| vatsarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi viṃśatiṃ tasya cātmajaḥ | pulastyastrikamervekavarṣāyustasya vallabhā ||11|| meghaśrīranayoḥ sūnuḥ sa devo'bhūddaśānanaḥ | caturdaśasahasrābdaparamāyurmahītalam ||12|| pālayaanyadā kāntāsahāyaḥ krīḍituṃ vanam | gatvā lakeśvaraḥ khecarācalasthālakeśituḥ ||13||
tadanantara jisake śabda aura artha sunane yogya haiṃ tathā vāṇī sārapūrṇa hai aisā purohita, 'mahārāja āpa yaha kathā śravaṇa karaneke yogya haiṃ| isa prakāra mahārāja daśarathako sambodhita kara apane yaśarūpī lakṣmīse daśoṃ diśāoṃke mukhako prakāśita karanevāle rāvaṇake bhavāntara kahane lagā||1-2|| usane kahā ki dhātakīkhaṇḍa dvīpake pūrva bharatakṣetrameṃ svargalokake samāna ābhāvālā evaṃ pṛthivīke guṇoṃse yukta sārasamuccaya nāmakā deśa hai || 3|| usake nāgapura nagarameṃ naradeva nāmakā rājā rājya karatā thā| vaha kisī eka dina ananta nāmaka gaṇadharake pāsa gayā, unheṃ vandanā kara usane unase dharma-kathā sunī aura virakta hokara bhogadeva nāmaka baḍa़e putrake lie rājya de diyā tathā saṃyama, dhāraṇa kara utkṛṣṭa tapaścaraṇa kiyā | tapaścaraṇa karate samaya usa mūrkhane kadācit capalavega nāmaka vidyādharoṃke rājāko dekhakara śīghra hī nidāna kara liyā| jaba āyukā anta āyā taba saṃnyāsa dhāraṇa kara saudharma svargameṃ deva huā|
athānantara-isī jambūdvīpake bharatakṣetrameṃ jo vijayārdha nāmakā mahān parvata hai usakī dakṣiṇa śreṇī meṃ meghakūṭa nāmakā nagara hai| usameṃ rājā vinamike vaṃśameṃ utpanna huā sahasragrīva nāmakā vidyādhara rājya karatā thā| usake bhāīkā putra bahuta balavān thā isalie usane krodhita hokara sahasnagrīṣako bāhara nikāla diyā thā| vaha sahasragrīva vahā~ se nikala kara laṅkā nagarī gayā aura vahā~ tīsa hajāra varṣa taka rājya karatā rahā ||4-6 || usake putrakā nāma śatagrīva thā| sahasragrīvake bāda usane vahā~ paccīsa hajāra varṣa taka rājya kiyā thā| usakā putra paścāśatagrīva thā usane bhī śatagrīvake bāda bīsa hajāra varṣa taka pṛthivīkā pālana kiyā thā, tadanantara paścāśadugrīvake pulastya nāmakā putra huā usane bhī pitāke bāda pandraha hajāra varṣa taka rājya kiyā| usakī strīkā nāma meghaśrī thā| una donoṃke vaha deva rāvaṇa nāmakā putra huā| caudaha hajāra varṣakī usakī utkṛṣṭa āyu thī, pitāke bāda vaha bhī pṛthivīkā pālana karane lagā| eka dina laṅkākā īśvara rāvaṇa apanī strīke sātha krīḍa़ā karaneke

tadanantara mantriyoṃne use samajhāyā ki rāmacandra honahāra balabhadra haiṃ, aura unakā choṭā bhāī lakṣmaṇa nārāyaṇa honevālā hai| isa samaya una donoṃkā pratāpa baḍha़ rahā haiṃ aura donoṃ hī mahān abhyudayake sanmukha haiṃ| sītā śīlavatī strī hai, yaha jīte jī tumhārī nahīṃ hogī| śīlavān puruṣakā - tiraskāra isī lokameṃ phala de detā hai| isake sivāya nagarameṃ aśubhakī sūcanā dene utpāta bhī ho rahe haiṃ isalie donoṃ lokoṃmeṃ ahita karane evaṃ yugāntataka apayaśa baḍha़ānevāle isa kukāryako usake pahale hī śīghra choḍa़ do jabataka ki yaha bāta sarvatra prasiddhiko prāpta hotī hai| isa prakāra mantriyoṃne yuktise bhare vacana rāvaṇase kahe| rāvaṇa pratyuttarameṃ kahane lagā ki 'isa taraha āpa loga binā kucha soce-vicāre hī yukti-viruddha vacana kyoṃ kahate haiṃ ? are, pratyakṣa vastumeṃ vicāra karanekī kyā āvaśyakatā hai ? dekho, sītākā apaharaṇa karanese hī mere cakraratna prakaṭa huā hai, isalie aba tīna khaṇḍakā ādhipatya mere hāthameṃ hī āgayā yaha socanā cāhiye| aisā kauna mūrkha hogā jo gharapara āī huī lakṣmīko pairase ṭhukarāvegā'| isa prakāra rāvaṇakā uttara sunakara hitakā upadeśa denevāle saba mantrī cupa ho gaye || 226-235||

kintu nākāśagāmitvasāmarthya teṣu vidyate | tasmātsenāpatiḥ preṣyastvayāyaṃ nūtanaḥ kṛtaḥ || 388 || raṣṭamārgaḥ parāvṛṣyaḥ siddhakāryaḥ śratāgamaḥ | jātyādividyāsampannaḥ syādasmātkāryanirṇayaḥ || 389 || ityetadupadeśena manovegābhidhānakam | vijayaṃ kumudākhyāna khyātaṃ ravigatiṃ hitam || 3.90 || sahāyīkṛsya sampūjya kumāra bhavato'paraḥ | kāryavitkāryakṛyāsti nātreti ślāghayāpaḥ || 39 || pavamānātmajaṃ vācyastvayaivaṃ sa vibhīṣaṇaḥ | atra tvameva dharmajñaḥ prājñaḥ kāryavipākavit || 392|| hito lakkeśvarāyāsmai sūryavaṃśānimāya ca | sītāharaṇamanyāyyamākalpamayaśaskaram || 393 || apathyamiti saṃśrāvya rāvaṇaṃ ratimohitam | mocanīyā tvayā sītā tathā sati bhavatkulam || 394 || tvayaiva rakṣitaṃ pāpādapāyādapavādataḥ | iti sāmoktibhistasmin svīkṛte svīkṛtā dviṣaḥ || 395 ||

aura kāryake paripāka-phalako jānanevāle haiṃ| laṅkāke īśvara rāvaṇa aura sūryavaṃśake pradhāna rāmacandra donoṃkā hita karanevāle haiṃ, isalie āpa rāvaṇase kahie-jo tū sītāko harakara lāyā hai so terā yaha kārya anyāyapūrṇa hai, kalpāntakāla taka apayaśa karanevālā hai, tara
hai, tathā ahitakārī hai| isa prakāra ratise mohita rāvaṇako sunākara āpa sītāko chuḍa़ā dījiye| aisā karane para āpa apane kulakī pāpase, vināśase tathā apavādase svayaṃ hī rakṣā kara leṃge| isa prakārakī sāmoktiyoṃse yadi vibhīṣaṇa vaśameṃ ho gayā to śatru apane vaśameṃ hī samajhiye | he dūtottama ! itanā hī nahīṃ, lakṣmīke sāthasātha sītā bhī āī huī hī samajhie| isake sivāya aura jo kucha karane yogya kārya hoṃ unakā tathā śatruke samācāroṃkā nirṇaya kara śīghra hī mere pāsa vāpisa āo|| 360-366|| isa prakāra kahakara rāmacandrane aṇumānako sahāyakoṃke sātha bidā kiyā| kumāra aṇumāna bhī rāmacandrako namaskāra kara gayā aura śīghra hī laṅkā pahu~ca gayā| vahā~ usane saba samācāra jānakara vibhīṣaṇake darśana kiye

hai to isameṃ āpakā aparādha nahīṃ hai vaha pāpī apane āpa hī naṣṭa hogā| 401 || isa samaya jinakī lakṣmī baḍha़ rahī hai aise rāmacandrako dekha unake puṇyase prerita huī tathā 'hama logoṃko donoṃ lokoṃkā eka kalyāṇa karanevāle rāmacandrajīkī śaraṇa jānā cāhie, isa prakāra anurāgase bharī raṇakī bhāvanāse otaprota pacāsa karoḍa़ caurāsī lākha bhūmigocariyoṃkī senā aura sāḍha़e tīna karoḍa़ vidyādharoṃkī senā svayaṃ hī unase ā milī hai| ve rāmacandra itanī saba senā tathā lakṣmaṇako sātha lekara svayaṃ hī yahā~ ā pahu~ceṃge| yadyapi ve sītāke samāna vidyādharoṃke rājā rāvaṇakī lakṣmīko bhī āja hī haranemeṃ samartha haiṃ kintu unakā āpameṃ svābhāvika prema hai isīlie unhoṃne mujhe bhejā hai| kyā āpa isa taraha ke satra samācāra nahīṃ jānate ? isa prakāra aṇumānake vacana sunakara kāryako jānanevālā vibhīṣaṇa usī samaya use rāvaṇake samīpa le jākara nivedana karane lagā ki he deva ! rāmacandrane yaha dṛta āpake pāsa bhejā hai| 402-407 || buddhimān tathā spaṣṭa aura madhura śabda bolanevāle aṇumānne bhī vinayapūrvaka rāvaṇake darśana kiye, yogya bheṃṭa samarpita kī| tadanantara rāvaṇake dvārā batalāye hue āsana para baiṭhakara śravaṇa karaneke yogya hita mita śabdoṃ dvārā usane isa prakāra kahanā śurū kiyā ki he deva,suniye||408-406|| jo apane tejase baḍha़ rahe haiṃ, jinakī buddhi tathā sāhasa sabako apane anukūla banānevālā hai, guṇa hī jinake ābhūṣaṇa haiṃ tathā jo kuśala yukta haiṃ aise rājā rāmacandrane isa samaya ayodhyānagarameṃ hī virājamāna hokara tīna khaṇḍake eka svāmī āpakā pahale to kaśala-praśna pachā hai aura phira yaha kahalā bhejā hai ki āpa sītāko kisī dūsarekī samajha kara le āye haiṃ| parantu vaha merī hai, āpa binā jāne lāye haiṃ isalie kucha bigaḍa़ā nahīṃ hai| āpa buddhimān haiṃ ataḥ use śīghra bheja dījie || 410-412 || yadi āpa sītāko na bhejeṃge to vinami vaṃśake eka ratna aura mahātmā svarūpa āpakā yaha vicitra kārya dharma tathā sukhakā vighāta karanevāla hogā||413 || kulīna putrarūpī mahāsāgarako yaha kalaṅka dhāraṇa karanā ucita nahīṃ hai| ata sītāko choḍa़ne rūpa baḍa़ī-baḍa़ī taraṅgoṃke dvārā ise bāhara pheṃka denā cāhie || 414|| aṇumānake yaha vacana sanakara rāvaṇane uttara diyā ki maiṃ sītāko binā jāne nahīṃ lāyā haṃ kinta jānakara lāya hū~| maiṃ rājā hūṃ ataḥ sarva ratna mere hī haiṃ aura viśeṣa kara strīratna to merā hī hai| tumhāre rāja

rāmacandrane jo kahalā bhejā hai ki sītāko bheja do so kyā aisā kahanā use yogya hai || 415-416 || [ vaha abhimāniyoṃmeṃ baḍa़ā abhimānī mālūma hotā hai| vaha merī śreṣṭhatāko nahīṃ jānatā hai | 'mere cakraratna utpanna huā hai| yaha samācāra kyā usake kānoke samīpa taka nahīṃ pahuṃcā hai ? bhūmigocariyoṃ tathā vidyādhara rājāoṃke mukuṭoṃ para mere caraṇa-yugala, sthala-kamala-gulābake samāna suśobhita hote haiṃ yaha bāta ābāla-gopāla prasiddha hai-baḍa़ese lekara choṭe taka saba jānate haiṃ| sītā merī hai yaha bāta to bahuta cauḍa़ī hai kintu samasta vijayādha parvata taka merā hai| mere sivāya sītā kisī anyakī nahīṃ ho sakatī| tumhārā rājā jo ise grahaṇa karanā cāhatā hai vaha parākramī nahīṃ hai-śūra-vīra nahīṃ hai| isa sītāko athavā anya kisī strīko grahaṇa karanekī usameṃ śakti hai to vaha yahā~ āve aura yuddhake dvārā mujhe jīta kara śīghra hī sītāko le jāve | kauna manā karatā hai ? ] isa prakāra bhāgyakī preraṇāse rāvaṇake nāśako sūcita karanevāle vacana sunakara aṇumānne manameṃ vicāra kiyā ki isa samaya rāmacandrake abhyudayako prakaṭa karanevāle śubha sūcaka nimitta ho rahe haiṃ aura isa viṣayameṃ mujhe bhī yahī iṣṭa hai-maiṃ cāhatā hū~ ki rāmacandra yahā~ ākara yuddhameṃ rāvaṇako parāsta kareṃ aura apanā abhyudaya baḍha़āveṃ ||417-418 || tadanantara vaha aṇumān rāmacandrakī orase duṣṭa aura durācārī rāvaṇase phira kahane lagā ki 'śrāpa anyāyako rokanevāle haiṃ, yadi rokanevāleko hī rokanā paḍa़e to samudra meṃ baḍa़vānalake samāna use kauna roka sakatā hai ? yaha sītā abhedya hai-ise koī vicalita nahīṃ kara sakatā aura maiṃ siṃhake samāna parākramī prasiddha rāmacandra hū~ || 416-420 || isa akāryake karanese jaba taka candramā rahegā tabataka āpakī niṣprayojana akīrti banī rahegī isa bātakā bhī āpako vicāra karanā ucita hai|| maiṃne bhāīpaneke sambandhase āpake lie hitakārī vacana kahe haiṃ| he svāmin ! yadi āpako rucikara hoṃ to grahaṇa kījie anyathā mata kījiye|' isa prakāra dūta-aṇumānako vacana sunakara rāvaṇa phira kahane lagā||421-422 || ki 'cū~ki rājā janakane ahaṃkāra vaśa mujhe sūcanā diye binā hī yaha sītā rūpī ratna rāmacandrake lie diyā thā isalie krodhase maiṃ ise le āyā hūṃ || 423 || mere yogya vastu svīkāra karanese yadi merī akīrti hotī hai to ho| vaha rāmacandra to mere hāthase cakraratna bhī grahaṇa karanā cāhatā hai| isa prakāra rāvaṇane kahā| tadanantara aṇumān rāvaṇake kahe anusāra usase prasanna tathā gambhīra vacana kahane lagā ki sītā maiṃne harī hai yaha āpa kyoṃ kahate haiṃ ? samudravijayane vicāra kiyā ki yadi ise spaṣṭa hī manā kiyā jātā hai to saṃbhava hai yaha vimukha ho jāvegā | isalie unhoṃne kumāra vasudevako ekāntameṃ bulākara kahā ki 'he kumāra! tumhāre śarīrakī kānti āja badalī-sī mālūma hotī hai isalie tumheṃ ṭhaṇḍī havā ādimeṃ yaha vyarthakā bhramaṇa choḍa़ denā cāhie | yadi bhramaṇakī icchā hī hai to rājabhavanake cāroṃ ora dhārāgṛha, manohara-vana, rājamandira, tathā kṛtrima parvata ādi para jahā~ icchā ho mantriyoṃ, sāmantoṃ, pradhāna yoddhāoṃ athavā mahāmantriyoṃke putroṃ ādike sātha bhramaṇa karo |' mahārāja vasudevakī bāta sunakara kumāra vasudeva aisā hī karane lage so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki śuddha buddhivāle puruṣa prāptajanoṃke vacanoṃko amṛta jaisā grahaṇa karate haiṃ || 224-228 || kumāra isa prakāra rājamandirake āsapāsa hī bhramaṇa karane lage | eka dina jise bahuta bolane kī ādata thī aura jo svecchānusāra ācaraṇa karanemeṃ utsuka rahatā thā aisā nipuṇamati nāmakā sevaka kumāra vasudevase kahane lagā ki isa upāya se mahārājane āpako bāhara nikalanese rokā hai | kumārane bhī usa sevakase pūchā ki mahārājane aisā kyoṃ kiyā hai ? uttarameṃ vaha kahane lagā ki jaba āpa bāhara nikalate haiṃ taba āpakā sundara rūpa dekhanese nagarakī striyoṃkā cāritra śithila ho jātā hai, ve kāmase ākula ho jātī haiṃ, lajjā choḍa़ detī haiṃ, viparīta ceṣṭāe~ karane lagatī haiṃ, kanyāe~ sadhavāe~ aura vidhavāe~ sabhī madirā pī huīke samāna ho jātī haiṃ, kitanī hī striyoṃkā saba śarīra pasīnāse tarabatara ho jātā hai; kitanī hī striyoṃke netra ādhe khule raha jāte haiṃ, kitanī hī striyā~ pahananeke vastra choḍa़ detī haiṃ, kitanī hī bhojana choḍa़ detī haiṃ, kitanī hī gurujanoṃ kā tiraskāra kara baiṭhatī haiṃ, kitanī hī rakṣakoṃko lalakāra detī haiṃ, kitanī hī apane patiyoṃkī upekṣā kara detī haiṃ, kitanī hī putroṃkī paravāha nahīṃ karatī haiṃ, kitanī hī putroṃko bandara samajha kara dūra pheṃka detī haiṃ, kitanī hī kambalako hī uttama vastra samajhakara pahina letī haiṃ, kitanī kīcaḍa़ko aṅgarāga samajhakara śarīra para lapeṭa letī haiṃ aura kitanī hī lalāṭako netra samajha kara usī para kajjala lagā letī haiṃ| apanī-apanī samasta striyoṃkī aisī viparīta ceṣṭā dekha samasta nagaranivāsī baḍa़e duḥkhī hue aura unhoṃne śabdoṃ dvārā mahārājase isa bātakā nivedana kiyā | mahārājane bhī isa upāya se āpakī aisī vyavasthā kī hai | nipuṇamati sevakakī bāta sunakara usakī parīkṣā 1 kha0, ga0, 60, ma0 sammataḥ pāṭhaḥ | la0 pustake tu 'kumāra vapuretatte paśyāmi kimivānyathā' iti pāṭhaḥ | 2 viceṣṭitam ga0 | 3 samākulān la0 | 4_ svāstāstathā-la0 | 5 tathā ma0, la0 | 6 kha0, ga0, pa0, ma0, saṃmataḥ pāṭhaḥ, la0 pustake tu 'tavāgrajasya devasya nādeśo'smākamīdṛśaḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ |
